name: Teagasc Client Relationship Module (CRM)
title: The new Teagasc Client Relationship Module (CRM) will be used by advisors to manage client interactions and diaries etc.
desc:
Client management and advisor diary components for Teagasc are handled in a new Client Relationship Module (CRM). The CRM system is a Microsoft product and can therefore be integrated with MS Outlook, Document Management System etc. 

Teagasc advisors use the system to complete a diary and expense module. Advisors use the Diary module to report their main activities during the week whereas they use the Expense module to enter expenses against a specific week.  Once all activities are accounted for, advisors submit their diaries for approval. The system will be developed over time to make it easier for advisors to interact with clients. 

In the short term the new CRM system will:
• Continue as a client management system as currently used.
• Provide for improved management of contact details, - removal of duplicates and better management of farms, farm family members and students etc.
• Enable improved communication and management of groups for electronic communication.
• Improve efficiency of diary management and alignment with MS calendar
• Be used to meet new requirements such as communication and management of new schemes with tight deadlines.

In the medium term the new CRM system will:
• Allow for improved event management campaigns
• Allow for further integration with other systems and websites and allow for improved analysis of client data and service requirements
• Streamline the management of delivery of services to clients by different advisors across different business units.
• Improve continuity for advisors and clients when there is staff movement or absence.
• Facilitates mobile access – the CRM platform will be accessible via a range of of mobile devices and will be able to be accessed on farm by advisors
• Provide the basis for providing information to clients via a client portal where clients can “selfserve” information

In the long term the new CRM system will:
• Support “One Teagasc” by providing a single system centred around the customer/client which can hold an organisation wide record of all interactions with a client, and allow the recording of clients’ interests so that anyone in the organisation can understand the full context of the client’s relationship with the organisation, and communications can be tailored specifically for client interests and delivered through the media preferred by the client.

name: Fertiliser relative values online calculator
title: Relative Value of chemical Fertilisers to help farmers choose low cost fertiliser blends and compounds (Using Urea)
desc:
This online calculator allows advisers and farmers compare the relative value of NPK fertiliser blends and compounds at any point in time based on the comparable price of three of the main fertilizers on the market. The primary components of fertilizers are nitrogen (N), phosphorous (P) and potassium (K). This program calculates the relative cost of a unit of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium and using this information calculates the value of other compound fertilizers, depending on the proportion of each component in it. I should be noted that the calculator uses elemental N, P and K values expressed as % of the mixture. (some compound refer to % p2o5 which you convert by multiplying by 0.437 also K is often referred to as k2o which can be converted by multiplying by 0.83)
The input sheet consists of a table of the main fertilizers available on the market, their component analysis and current price. Additional fertilisers formulations can be added. Fertiliser prices marked with an asterisk must be entered for the calculation to be done.
The calculator uses two NPK compound fertiilisers (0-10-20 and 0-7-30) which are common on the Irish market to calculate the value of the P and K component. It has two versions which allow you to use Urea (46%N) or Calcium Ammonium Nitrate (27%N) to calculate the value of the N component.
The practical application of this calculator is to help farmers choose the best value combination of fertilisers when buying their required fertilisers and matching these to the crop/soil needs. All an advisor needs is a list of fertiliser types available and a corresponding price list. 
An MS Excel Version of this calculator is avaliable for offline use.

name: gaiasense
title: An innovative, multi-dimensional smart farming system
titleOther: Καινοτόμο σύστημα ευφυούς γεωργίας τεσσάρων διαστάσεων
desc:
Gaiasense, an innovative smart farming system designed and developed by NEUROPUBLIC S.A., collects data from the field (atmospheric and soil data), the satellite (Earth Observation data), the scientist (on farm observations, measurements and sampling), and the farmer (recording of farming activities). This data feeds scientific models for the fertilization, irrigation and crop protection of each crop, adjusted to the microclimatic conditions of each site. Then, gaiasense provides advice to agronomists and consequently farmers, so that they can meet the exact needs of each specific crop in terms of nutrients, irrigation water and crop protection measures.

Gaiasense supports a constantly growing number of crops, both open field and in greenhouses, conventional and organic. Its modular design allows the adaptation to different crops and adjustment to different microclimatic conditions. It contributes to better quality and higher yields, with reduced production cost and lower environmental footprint.

Agricultural advisors play a key role in the process, as they are the ones who evaluate the smart farming advice, adjusting it accordingly based on their experience, and then share it with farmers, also guiding them in the application of the advice in the field.

Gaiasense provides agricultural advisors with valuable digital tools, data and information that they need in order to provide more accurate advice to farmers, so that they can reap the benefits of smart farming without requiring any kind of investment in expensive technological equipment nor specialized digital skills.
descOther:
Το gaiasense συλλέγει δεδομένα από το χωράφι (ατμοσφαιρικά και εδαφικά), το δορυφόρο (δεδομένα Παρατήρησης Γης), τον επιστήμονα (επιτόπιες παρατηρήσεις, μετρήσεις και δειγματοληψίες στο χωράφι), και τον αγρότη (καταγραφή καλλιεργητικών εργασιών). Τα δεδομένα αυτά τροφοδοτούν επιστημονικά μοντέλα για τη λίπανση, την άρδευση και τη φυτοπροστασία κάθε καλλιέργειας, προσαρμοσμένα στις μικροκλιματικές συνθήκες κάθε περιοχής, παρέχοντας συμβουλή σε γεωπόνους και αγρότες για να καλύψουν με ακρίβεια τις ανάγκες της καλλιέργειας σε θρεπτικά, αρδευτικό νερό και μέσα φυτοπροστασίας.

Υποστηρίζει έναν συνεχώς αυξανόμενο αριθμό καλλιεργειών, υπαίθριων και θερμοκηπιακών, συμβατικών και βιολογικών. Η αρχιτεκτονική του επιτρέπει την εύκολη προσαρμογή του για νέες καλλιέργειες και σημαντικά διαφορετικές εδαφοκλιματικές συνθήκες. name: Net Promoter Score (Teagasc)
title: Net Promoter Score, or NPS, measures clients experience of the Teagasc advisory service and provides a metric to anchor Customer Relationship Management
desc:
To gauge the satisfaction of its clients (44,000 in 2020) with its Advisory Service, Teagasc is using a Net Promoter Score-based questionnaire, delivered via SMS (Short Message Service) to its client base.  The SMS contains a link to a short questionnaire.

As a backup, the potential to phone clients for their responses is available for those who can’t respond directly to the SMS for whatever reason. 

The NPS is an alternative to traditional customer satisfaction research.  It is internationally recognised, simple to implement, easy to calculate and comparable over time and locations.  It is commonly used across many industries. It is based on 2 essential questions.  
1) How likely are you to recommend Teagasc to family, colleagues and friends?  Responses are requested on a 10 point scale ranging from ‘not at all likely’ to ‘extremely likely’.
2) A follow on open ended question asks for more detail on the respondent’s choice. 

Answers to question 1) generate an overall score based on the following categorisation. 
- Clients who rate Teagasc 9-10 are ‘promoters’.  They are positive about the service they are receiving and are extremely likely to recommend Teagasc
- Clients who rate Teagasc 7-8 are ‘passively satisfied’.  They are still positive about the service but are unlikely to actively recommend Teagasc and improve its reputation.
- Clients who rate Teagasc 0-6 are ‘detractors’.   They are less positive about the service and who may damage Teagasc through negative word of mouth. 

The NPS is not expressed as a percentage but as an absolute number lying between -100 and +100. For instance, if there are 25% Promoters, 55% Passives and 20% Detractors, the NPS will be +5.
The score is comparable across time and space.  Therefore, it can become a target for action to improve the score.  

Verbatim answers to question 2) provide detail on the score and help focus attention on what needs to change in terms of service delivery in order to improve the score.

name: Organic farm knowledge
title: Organic farm knowledge - A unique resource with tools for farmers across Europe
titleOther: Bio Bauern
desc:
The online platform Organic Farm Knowledge intends to promote productivity and quality in organic farming across Europe by providing access to a wide range of tools and knowledge exchange among farmers, farm advisers and scientists. FiBL maintains the platform in collaboration with partners from the OK-Net Ecofeed project. The core of the platform is the "toolbox". Available tools include, for instance, practical tips, factsheets, guides, online calculation tools and videos. By promoting the exchange of good practices, it supports farmers and advisors in putting innovations into practice.

Topics covered on the platform cover a wide range of knowledge about organic farming, from arable crops, soil quality and fertility, nutrient management, pest and disease control to pigs, broilers, laying hens, feeding and ration planning and the handling of harvested feed. This facilitates access to practical tools developed within the framework of research projects with farmers playing a central role in building the platform from its roots.

-How can I find a tool?
For each of the themes of Organic Farm Knowledge, a dedicated theme page has been set up where the tools related to a theme can be found along with some background information. An extensive search function is also available, and tools can be browsed by theme, keyword, tool type, country of origin, organisation and language.

-Are the tools available in all languages?
While not all tools are available in all languages, their summaries and key recommendations are translated – via automatic translation – into Bulgarian, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Serbian, Spanish and Swedish.

-How can I inform myself about new tools?
All tools are announced on the Organic Farm Knowledge platform with a news item. The latest tools are also highlighted in a separate box on the homepage and on the relevant theme pages. The tools are also promoted via social media: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/organicfarmknowledge, and Twitter https://twitter.com/farm_knowledge.

-Can I rate and comment on a tool or engage in discussions?
Yes, you can rate tools directly on the platform. For discussions, we offer the Organic Farm Knowledge Facebook and Twitter accounts, where each tool is posted and can be commented upon. Also, the discussion function, DISQUS on the platform itself, can be used.
descOther:
Die Online-Plattform Organic Farm Knowledge will die Produktivität und Qualität in der ökologischen Landwirtschaft in ganz Europa fördern, indem sie Zugang zu einer breiten Palette von Instrumenten und zum Wissensaustausch zwischen Landwirten, Betriebsberatern und Wissenschaftlern bietet. Das FiBL unterhält die Plattform in Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern aus dem OK-Net Ecofeed-Projekt. Das Herzstück der Plattform ist der "Werkzeugkasten". Zu den verfügbaren Werkzeugen gehören zum Beispiel praktische Tipps, Factsheets, Leitfäden, Online-Berechnungswerkzeuge und Videos.

Die auf der Plattform behandelten Themen decken ein breites Wissensspektrum über den biologischen Landbau ab, von Ackerkulturen, Bodenqualität und Fruchtbarkeit, Nährstoffmanagement, Schädlings- und Krankheitsbekämpfung bis hin zu Schweinen, Broilern, Legehennen, Fütterungs- und Rationsplanung und dem Umgang mit geerntetem Futter. Dies erleichtert den Zugang zu praktischen Werkzeugen, die im Rahmen von Forschungsprojekten mit Landwirten entwickelt wurden, die beim Aufbau der Plattform von ihren Wurzeln her eine zentrale Rolle spielen.

-Wie kann ich ein Werkzeug finden?
Für jedes der Themen des Wissens über den Biolandbau wurde eine eigene Themenseite eingerichtet, auf der die mit einem Thema verbundenen Werkzeuge zusammen mit einigen Hintergrundinformationen zu finden sind. Eine umfangreiche Suchfunktion steht ebenfalls zur Verfügung, und die Werkzeuge können nach Thema, Schlüsselwort, Werkzeugtyp, Herkunftsland, Organisation und Sprache durchsucht werden.

-Sind die Tools in allen Sprachen verfügbar?
Zwar sind nicht alle Tools in allen Sprachen verfügbar, aber ihre Zusammenfassungen und Schlüsselempfehlungen werden - mittels automatischer Übersetzung - ins 12 Sprachen übersetzt.

-Wie kann ich mich über neue Tools informieren?
Alle Tools werden auf der Plattform mit einer Nachricht angekündigt. Die neuesten Tools werden auch in einem separaten Kasten auf der Homepage und auf den entsprechenden Themenseiten hervorgehoben. Die Tools werden auch über soziale Medien beworben: Facebook und Twitter.

-Kann ich ein Tool bewerten und kommentieren oder mich an Diskussionen beteiligen?
Sie können Tools direkt auf der Plattform bewerten. Für Diskussionen bieten wir die Facebook- und Twitter-Accounts Organic Farm Knowledge an, wo jedes Tool gepostet wird und kommentiert werden kann oder die Diskussionsfunktion, DISQUS auf der Plattform selbst.

name: EkonMOD milk
providerName: Miroslav Záhradník from National Agricultural and Food Centre (NPPC)
title: This application assists to better understand the dynamics of the dairy herd structure and to improve decision-making in Slovak conditions, including the GHG mitigation agenda
titleOther: EkonMOD milk - ekonomický model chovu dojníc
desc: Generally, each of the application under the umbrella of the EkonMOD milk platform is used to evaluate the economic consequences of different on-farm strategies, including a farm-focused calculator for greenhouse gases (GHG) emissions from a user-specified dairy farm allow individual dairy farm managers to calculate the emission factors and yields of methane, ammonia and nitrous oxide of dairy cows, heifers, calves and fattened bulls, if present on dairy farm. The interactive dairy farm model approach was developed at farm level and based on a static approach. This modeling framework was built to serve the purposes of a wider research strategy. The main objective of this activities concerns an analysis of possible effects of changing conditions on different Slovak dairy cow operations. The model developed can be used to run various scenarios in the field of structural and technical change on dairy farms. Moreover, it can be tailored for dairy farms that differ in intensity and scale. The complex application analyses the input parameters of the breeding intensity, including specified parameters of reproduction and performance, and determines a detailed herd turnover and status of the animals for each category within the given farm. Included in the model is also the determination of the nutritional requirements in feed doses for all categories of animals at the dairy farm. Balancing of the nutritional requirements and the nutritional content of the feed, which the breeder submitted into the model, is done automatically. Following that, the total requirements for feed as well as the storage space and litter requirements. The analysis of total production of marketable products is then, in the context of the particular farm and its characteristics, supplemented by complex evaluation of the milk production costs. The idea behind the application is to not only evaluate the existing state but to provide also an analysis of possible changes, which the farmer is considering or forced to implement. The accuracy, independence and timeliness of business analyses is always based on the relevancy of input parameters, but also on their character, which is that of a business plan. In communicating the idea of individual farm economy evaluation, the authors of the application consider this fact to be a decisive influence and therefore neither data nor any other information are archived or otherwise processed at this stage.
descOther: Platforma EkonMOD milk kontinuálne integruje doteraz vyvinuté aplikácie z oblasti hodnotenia ekonomiky chovu dojného dobytka. Aplikácia na základe zadaných parametrov intenzity chovu, vrátane špecifikácie ukazovateľov reprodukcie a úžitkovosti, stanovuje detailný obrat stáda a stav zvierat v jednotlivých kategóriách v rámci konkrétneho chovu. Súčasťou modelu je aj stanovovanie požiadaviek na obsah živín v kŕmnych dávkach pre všetky kategórie zvierat na mliekovej farme. Bilancia medzi potrebou živín a obsahom živín v chovateľom používaných krmivách, ktoré zadal do modelu prebieha automaticky. V nadväznosti na to je stanovená celková potreba skŕmiteľných krmív a potreba ornej pôdy pre výrobu krmovín. Analýza je doplnená aj o požiadavku na skladovacie priestory a potrebu podstielky. Celková produkcia trhových produktov je následne v kontexte konkrétneho systému chovu a jeho charakteristík doplnená o komplexné hodnotenie nákladovosti výroby mlieka. Myšlienkou vyvíjanej aplikácie nie je len hodnotenie konkrétneho stavu, ale aj analýza prípadných zmien, ktoré chovateľ zvažuje, prípadne musí podstúpiť. Správnosť, nezávislosť a včasnosť podnikových analýz je vždy založená na relevantnosti vstupných údajov, ale aj na ich samotnej povahe, ktorá má charakter podnikateľského zámeru. Autorský tím túto skutočnosť pri komunikácií myšlienky individuálneho hodnotenia ekonomiky chovu vníma v tejto fáze ako rozhodujúcu a preto nie sú žiadne dáta ani iné informácie archivované ani inak spracovávané. Aplikácia umožňuje aj hodnotenie environmentálnej stopy a stanovuje emisie z chovu. Účinná medziodborová spolupráca na vývoji jednotlivých modulov predstavuje pridanú hodnotu pre chovateľa, ktorý získava možnosť na jednom mieste a v minimálnom čase generovať svoje vlastné podnikové analýzy, prostredníctvom ktorých dokáže konkretizovať svoje možnosti a limity pri danom finančnom rámci.

name: Smartpharm
title: This application digitizes the veterinary register in breeding, to promote the traceability of treatments, to the strip / room / hut or to the animal, from birth to slaughter.
titleOther: Cette application digitalise le registre vétérinaire en élevage, pour favoriser la traçabilité des traitements, à la salle/case ou à l’animal, de la naissance jusqu’à l’abattage.
desc:
This solution automates and simplifies the recording of information relating to health treatments by recording the dose and the animal treated. SmartPharm therefore constitutes a less tedious solution, avoiding manual entry in the breeding register and allows the exploitation of the information collected in a database. Thus, alerts are sent directly to the farmer's smartphone, for example in the event of too short a waiting period or an inappropriate dosage. The farmer can also compare his practices to IFIP references or even value animals that have received no treatment in a differentiated manner.

In practice, the farmer scans a contactless (NFC) "medication" card with his smartphone and assigns treatment to the animal using an RFID chip or to the room / box using an NFC card. A breeding-specific database gathers this information and the breeder can compare his practices with IFIP references on a Dashboard.
descOther:
Cette solution automatise et simplifie l’enregistrement des informations relatives aux traitements sanitaires en enregistrant la dose et l’animal soigné. SmartPharm constitue donc une solution moins fastidieuse, évitant la saisie manuelle dans le registre d’élevage et permet l’exploitation des informations collectées dans une base de données. Ainsi, des alertes sont envoyées directement sur le smartphone de l’éleveur, par exemple en cas de durée d’attente trop courte ou de posologie inappropriée. L’éleveur peut également comparer ses pratiques aux références IFIP ou encore valoriser de façon différenciée les animaux n’ayant reçu aucun traitement. 

En pratique, l’éleveur scanne une carte sans-contact (NFC) « médicament » avec son smartphone et affecte un traitement à l’animal par puce RFID ou à la salle/case par carte NFC. Une base de données propre à l’élevage regroupe ces informations et l’éleveur peut comparer ses pratiques avec les références IFIP sur un Tableau de Bord.
keywords: veterinary register, animal production, traceability
creator: 617016951f2f225b093905b0

name: GEEP
title: Operational tool for technical management of environmental impacts.
titleOther: Outil opérationnel pour un pilotage technique des impacts environnementaux.
desc:
The GEEP tool is accessible, (1) to any breeder already involved in monitoring their technical performance (GTE) and wishing to determine and monitor their environmental performance in addition; (2) any adviser wishing to support breeders in this process (GEEP relay).

The tool offers 9 quantitative environmental performance indicators: water and energy consumption, ammonia and greenhouse gas emissions, nitrogen and phosphorus emissions, production of waste.

These indicators are complementary to the Technical-Economic Management (GTE) and Technical Management of Sow Herds (GTTT) indicators.

Their format (quantitative indicator, expressed in a common unit) allows comparison between farms.

A web interface (http://geep.ifip.asso.fr) allows an annual calculation of environmental indicators and the identification of good environmental practices to progress.

The network is "private": the data and results of individual indicators are confidential and the collective results are only accessible to members of the network.
descOther:
L’outil GEEP est accessible, (1) à tout éleveur déjà impliqué dans un suivi de ses performances techniques (GTE) et souhaitant déterminer et suivre en complément ses performances environnementales ; (2) tout conseiller souhaitant accompagner des éleveurs dans cette démarche (relais GEEP).

L’outil propose 9 indicateurs de performances environnementales quantitatifs : consommations d’eau et d’énergie, émissions d’ammoniac et de gaz à effet de serre, rejets d’azote et de phosphore, production de déchets.

Ces indicateurs sont complémentaires des indicateurs de la Gestion Technico- économique (GTE) et de la Gestion Technique des Troupeaux de Truies (GTTT).

Leur format (indicateur quantitatif, exprimé dans une unité commune) permet la comparaison entre élevages.

Une interface web (http://geep.ifip.asso.fr) permet un calcul annuel des indicateurs environnementaux et l’identification de bonnes pratiques environnementales pour progresser.

Le réseau est « privé » : les données et résultats d’indicateurs individuels sont confidentiels et les résultats collectifs sont seulement accessibles aux membres du réseau.
keywords: environmental performances, pig, good practices
creator: 617016951f2f225b093905b0

name: Grassman
title: Mobile application dedicated to driving meadows from sowing to harvest
titleOther: Application mobile dédiée à la conduire des prairies du semis à la récolte
desc:
The application includes six modules dedicated to driving the meadow:

- "Compose": Depending on the geographic area and the typology of the prairie soil, the application will suggest species combinations, sowing doses and types of varieties to the breeder.

- "Fertilize": Once the composition has been chosen, the farmer will be advised on the doses of fertilizers to be supplied and their distribution.

- "Identify": The farmer can enter the weeds present for each plot and estimate the degree of soiling.

- "Fight": After identifying the weeds, the application gives some advice to fight against them mechanically or chemically.

- “Mowing”: Thanks to the seven-day weather data for each plot entered in the software, Grassman identifies the weather windows suitable for the forage harvest by taking into account the dominant species in each meadow and the harvesting method.

- "Qualify": It will be possible to estimate the quality of the forage harvested by sensory criteria (odor, presence of mold, dust, fiber level, color ...). This will identify the quality for each plot and define the category of animals per batch harvested.

According to the founding companies, the tool is not primarily intended to market seeds or advice. It is an expertise tool. "Grassman must help the farmer make the right decisions that will allow him to find better profitability in the management of his forage system," explains Laurent Victor, marketing and communications director Jouffray-Drillaud.

The decision support tool will be offered to breeders for an annual subscription of € 50. Each user can, if they wish, share their reports and exchange with other breeders or with their adviser.
descOther:
L'application comprend six modules dédiés à la conduite de la prairie :

- « Composer » : En fonction de la zone géographique et de la typologie du sol de la prairie, l'application proposera à l'éleveur des compositions d'espèces, des doses de semis et des types de variétés.

- « Fertiliser » : Une fois la composition choisie, l'éleveur se verra conseiller pour les doses de fertilisants à apporter et leur répartition.

- « Identifier » : L'éleveur peut saisir pour chaque parcelle les adventices présentes et en estimer le degré de salissement.

- « Lutter » : Après avoir identifié les adventices, l'application donne quelques conseils pour lutter contre celles-ci de façon mécanique ou chimique.

- « Faucher » : Grâce aux données météo à sept jours pour chaque parcelle rentrée dans le logiciel, Grassman identifie les fenêtres météo propices à la récolte du fourrage en prenant en compte les espèces dominantes dans chaque prairie et le mode de récolte.

- « Qualifier » : Il sera possible d'estimer la qualité du fourrage récolté par des critères sensoriels (odeur, présence de moisissures, poussière, niveau de fibre, couleur...). Cela permettra d'identifier la qualité pour chaque parcelle et de définir la catégorie d'animaux par lot récolté.

D'après les entreprises fondatrices, l'outil n'a pas pour vocation première de commercialiser des semences ou du conseil. Il s'agit d'un outil d'expertise. « Grassman doit aider l’éleveur à prendre les bonnes décisions qui lui permettront de trouver une meilleure rentabilité dans la gestion de son système fourrager », détaille Laurent Victor, directeur marketing et communication Jouffray-Drillaud.

L'outil d'aide à la décision sera proposé aux éleveurs pour un abonnement annuel de 50 €. Chaque utilisateur pourra s'il le souhaite, partager ses rapports et échanger avec d'autres éleveurs ou encore avec son conseiller.
keywords: meadows, decision support tool
keywordsOther: prairie, outil d'aide à la décision
creator: 617016951f2f225b093905b0

name: R-sim
title: A simulator to assess the risk of resistance developing according to its herbicidal practices
titleOther: Un simulateur pour évaluer le risque d'apparition de résistances selon ses pratiques herbicides
desc:
After having chosen a rotation among the 9 proposed, and one to three weeds present in the plot, the user enters the herbicidal practices for each crop and some data of agronomic practices.

As a result R-sim provides a level of risk for each crop, and overall for rotation. It also indicates whether agronomic practices increase this risk or on the contrary decrease it.

Finally, R-sim offers herbicide strategies for each rotation, making it possible to limit the risk of the appearance of resistant weeds. R-sim is also the OAD (decision-making aid tool) for the support plan for varieties tolerant to herbicides (HTV, rapeseed or sunflower varieties Clearfield® and sunflower ExpressSun) which brings together the signatories to the charter: Technical institutes, Coop de France, National Trade Federation, UFS (seed companies) and UIPP (plant protection manufacturers). It meets two objectives: to support the advice for the sale of its varieties in order to assess the risk and to provide monitoring of practices (registration for investigation on a user account) in order to assess whether the use of these varieties is a factor increased risk.
descOther:
Après avoir choisi une rotation parmi les 9 proposées, et  une à trois adventices présentes dans la parcelle, l'utilisateur saisit les pratiques herbicides pour chaque culture et quelques données de pratiques agronomiques.

En résultat R-sim fournit un niveau de risque pour chaque culture, et globalement pour la rotation. Il indique également si les pratiques agronomiques augmentent ce risque ou au contraire le diminuent.

Enfin, R-sim propose des stratégies herbicides pour chaque rotation, permettant de limiter le risque d'apparition d'adventices résistantesR-sim est aussi l’OAD (outil d’aide à la décision) du plan d’accompagnement des variétés tolérantes aux herbicides (VTH, variétés colza ou tournesol Clearfield® et tournesol ExpressSun) qui réunit les signataires de la charte : Instituts techniques, Coop de France, Fédération nationale du négoce, UFS (semenciers) et UIPP (industriels de la protection des plantes). Il répond à deux objectifs : appuyer le conseil à la vente de ses variétés afin d’évaluer le risque et alimenter un suivi des pratiques (enregistrement pour enquête sur un compte utilisateur) afin d’évaluer si l’utilisation de ces variétés est un facteur d’augmentation du risque.
keywords: herbicide, weeds, resistance
creator: 617016951f2f225b093905b0

name: myVar®
title: myVar® allows you to quickly access all Terres Inovia references on rapeseed, sunflower, soybean, flax and hemp varieties, and to optimize your variety choice.

desc:
The tool, intended for farmers and technicians, offers 4 main inputs:
- Consult the variety sheets. Each file brings together all the data for the variety: identity elements, classifications (disease, lodging, etc.), technological data, productivity results, CTPS evaluation results, commentary by Terres Inovia.
- Choose according to your criteria. From the exhaustive list of varieties sold, a filter system by criteria allows the user to select the varieties best suited to his situation and choices.
- Compare varieties. From a selected list of varieties, myVar® displays a comparative table with the possibility of sorting according to the different characteristics (web version), or a comparison graph (mobile application).
- Annual results and regional recommendations. myVar® provides results from the Terres Inovia varietal evaluation network (web version only).
descOther:
L’outil, destiné aux agriculteurs et aux techniciens, propose 4 entrées principales :
‐ Consulter les fiches variétés. Chaque fiche rassemble l’ensemble des données de la variété : éléments d’identité, classifications (maladie, verse, etc.), données  technologiques, résultats de productivité, résultats d’évaluation CTPS, commentaire de Terres Inovia.

name: Agroclimatic Information System for Irrigation (SiAR)
providerName: The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, Food and Environment through the Subdirectorate General for Irrigation and Rural Infrastructure
title: It allows the consultation and download of daily, weekly or monthly meteorological data from one or several stations.
desc:
1- Description of the project
The Agroclimatic Information System for Irrigation (SiAR) is an infrastructure that captures, records and disseminates the agroclimatic data necessary for calculating the water demand of irrigation areas, which allows for obtaining useful, rigorous and quality information and contributes to better planning, management, handling and control of irrigation operations.

The Ministry, through the Subdirectorate General of Irrigation and Water Economy has been developing, maintaining and updating SiAR for more than 13 years with the aim of being an instrument to meet the technological demands of all irrigation professionals and to achieve these objectives, SiAR is based on these four fundamental pillars:

Reliability of agroclimatological data: Having reliable information and providing greater accuracy in determining it.
Advice to irrigators: Optimising irrigation doses by means of knowledge of the most representative meteorological data, thus responding to the technological demands of irrigators in view of the consolidation and improvement of irrigation.
Economic and environmental benefits: reducing operating costs, optimizing water use and improving energy efficiency.
Planning, administration and management of water resources. By strengthening the technical strategies of the water administration for the planning, administration and management of both ground and surface waters.
Obtaining reliable data, together with the application of the most appropriate formula for calculating reference evapotranspiration for each area, provides greater accuracy in determining the water needs of irrigated crops.
keywords: SIAR, irrigation, water, crops, efficiency
creator: 5eff1416c2cbf12020b12795

name: Iberpix viewer
providerName: General Directorate of the National Geographic Institute.
title: The Iberpix 4 Viewer is a web application that aims to provide a tool to facilitate the location of different spaces throughout the country.
desc:
The Iberpix 4 Viewer is a web application that aims to provide a tool to facilitate the location of different spaces throughout the country.

Developed in Javascript and HTML5, it does not need previous installation in the client machine.

For the correct execution of the viewer the browser must comply with the HTML5, CSS3, JS standard.

The viewer comprises several groups of raster layers and a significant number of vectorial layers:

-Layers

oMap (MTN 1:2,000,000, MTN 1:1,250,000, MTN 1:500,000, MTN 1:200,000, MTN 1:50,000, MTN 1:25,000)

oImage (Sentinel 2, Orthophotos PNOA)

oStreet map Cartociudad

oRelief (DTM 1:200,000, DTM 1:25,000)

oFloor Occupation (Corine , SIOSE)

Historical Maps



-Additional layers

oAdministrative limits

Mapping Grids

oElevation

oHistorical PNOA

oUser files (GPS, KML,Shp, GeoJSON)



Similarly, raster layers from WMS/WMTS services can be displayed as well as vector layers in different formats (KML,GPX,Shape,GML, GeoJSON)

The desired areas can be displayed at any time at different scales (zoom in or out). Depending on the scale of the screen display, one or other layers of each group will be shown.

The application also offers, among others, visualization tools (image scrolling, zoom in on the peninsula and the Canary Islands, etc.), tools for measuring surfaces and distances, search, attribute querying and printing.

providerName: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food through the Directorate-General for Health of Agricultural Production
title: Database providing information on authorised plant protection products, approved active substances, instructions for registration of protection products and maximum residue limits
desc:
It consists of 5 sections that allow information to be obtained on the phytosanitary products authorised in Spain, active substances approved for their manufacture, instructions for the registration of phytosanitary products and maximum residue limits in plant products and documents on the official recognition of tests.

The section on phytosanitary products contains 4 menus that allow searches for phytosanitary products by registration number, trade name, active substance, crop and crop/plant, also allowing consultation of movements that have taken place in the Register of Phytosanitary Products between two dates. As the databases do not allow to ensure that the computer sweeps analyse details such as certain exceptional restrictions that may eventually be included in the authorisations, it has been foreseen that the user will have the possibility to have on screen a display of the complete resolution of the registration of the selected product with all the specific conditions established.

The section on approved active substances provides information on those authorised for use in the manufacture of plant protection products.

The updating of the database at 30-day intervals helps to make accurate, reliable and up-to-date information available to all users of this page, which will undoubtedly help greatly in making the use of Plant Protection Products more responsible, safer, more effective and increasingly more respectful of the environment.

The section on instructions for the registration of plant protection products has been designed to include documents of interest within the scope of the Official Register of Plant Protection Products and Equipment.

The section on maximum residue limits includes a compilation with all the current levels in Spain for plant products.
keywords: phytosanitary, pests, vegetables, disease, products
creator: 5eff1416c2cbf12020b12795

RICA deals with issues related to the agri-food and forestry sector. Nine categories have been created: agriculture, livestock, food and health, environment, rural development, marketing and markets, agrifood industry, water and inputs, and agrifood policy. Some categories have subcategories.
Operation
There are two sections related to daily information: News and Events. Normally, a selection is made between 20 and 30 News, which cover the agri-food sector at regional, national and international level. The Events are related to the food sector including those of formative character, those of transference to the sector and the scientific-technical ones in the geographical scope of Aragon.

The rest of the sections are related to knowledge: Consultations, Documents, Media Library, and Opinions and Experiences.

name: CostCheck: The Mastitis Cost Calculator
title: The objective of the CostCheck calculator is to allow each dairy farmer to estimate the potential gains in profit from reducing the incidence of mastitis on his/her dairy farm
desc:
This tool was developed by Teagasc researchers in consultation with the CellCheck Technical Working Group.

The CostCheck calculator is a Microsoft Excel based tool which has a user friendly interface and contains both a ready-reckoner and detailed calculation as options. The calculator can be used by farmers or advisors to help understand the impact that mastitis has on profitability on a farm. The CostCheck calculator is easy to use and will provide an instant cost associated with mastitis on the farm and should be used as a catalyst to the introduction of mastitis control programs.

Estimating the current cost of mastitis on Irish dairy farms is the first practical step in motivating farmers to improve mastitis control, thus enhancing milk quality and farm profitability.  Users of the tool have a choice of using either the Quick CostCheck calculator or the Complete CostCheck calculator. The Quick calculator requires only two inputs and provides an estimate of the impact of mastitis on net farm profit; the Complete CostCheck calculator allows the user to
input more data for a farm specific analysis.

On selecting the Quick calculator this screen is displayed. This is a short cost of mastitis calculator, whereby the only data entered by the user is the number of cows they are milking and the most recent annualised SCC category of their dairy farm (as reported in your milk statement). The calculator then returns an estimate of the reduction in net farm profit due to mastitis on the user’s dairy farm. If the user wants a more detailed analysis then he/she can select the Complete CostCheck button and this will bring the user back to the opening screen.

On selecting the Complete CostCheck calculator the user will see a screen where numerous inputs are required. The results are split into two sections; Summary Results and Detailed Results. The Summary Result provides an estimate of the gain from reducing SCC. The Detailed Results provides a breakdown of the cost components: milk production, treatment, culling and other costs.
keywords: Animal Health, Calculator, Dairy, mastitis
creator: 5e186b019b113a708c7e1b5e

name: VanBoven Farm Advisory Service
title: VanBoven - Start offering your clients drone-mapping services with the click of a button.
titleOther: VanBoven - Bied dronediensten aan met één druk op de knop!
desc:
In order to remain on top of the competition, farm advisors are always on the lookout for new opportunities for their clients. Technology can offer such opportunities. However, adopting and using new technologies often requires significant time investments from the advisors.

One such technology is the use of drones for agricultural mapping and monitoring purposes. Most advisors agree that accurate and up-to-date field maps would be beneficial for their clients, increase the efficiency of in-field inspections and help in communication with the client. However, adopting this technology is burdensome and requires investments in training and IT infrastructure.

VanBoven offers a service for advisors that tackles exactly this issue. The service is based around a proprietary software platform that helps in four areas:

1. Advisors should not have to fumble and experiment with camera and drone settings, flight paths etc. Therefore, with VanBoven, the advisor simply indicates what field he or she would like to map. The platform then generates the optimal flight path and settings and sends this to the drone over the air. The advisor only has to turn on the drone and press 'Go' in a mobile app. The whole flight is then executed autonomously.

2. A drone gathers up to 2.000 images of a single field. Advisors should not have to plough through this pile of data on their computers. Therefore VanBoven provides a small hardware device that can be used to automatically upload all images to the platform - no computers required! The platform automatically sorts out all the photos and stores them safely.

3. Once uploaded to the platform the images are automatically combined into a single field map. The result is a map similar to those in Google Earth, but with a resolution of up to 5 millimeters. Optionally index maps (Leaf Area Index, Green Area Index etc) can be derived.

4. The results are presented within 24 hours in a secure online environment. Advisors can log-in and inspect the captured fields, create annotations and/or share the maps with the client. This online environment can be provided as a white-label service, such that it fully integrates with the advisor's existing web-services and branding.

With VanBoven's service, farm advisors can offer drone services to their clients with minimal investment in training and technology.
descOther:
Voorblijven op de concurrentie doe je door altijd de nieuwste kansen voor je klanten te spotten. Soms kan een nieuwe technologie zo'n kans vormen. Echter vraagt het toepassen van nieuwe technieken om een serieuze investering van tijd en geld. En daar zit je, ook als adviseur, niet altijd op te wachten.

Een zo'n techniek is het gebruik van drones. De meeste adviseurs beamen dat nauwkeurige en up-to-date kaarten van toegevoegde waarde kunnen zijn. Voor de klant, maar ook voor de adviseur. Je zou immers meer gerichte inspecties kunnen uitvoeren, en zo'n kaart maakt ook communicatie met de klant een stuk makkelijker. Toch voelen de meeste adviseurs een drempel, want het verzamelen, verwerken en interpreteren van dronedata vereist toch een aardige investering in training en IT.

VanBoven biedt een dienst aan adviseurs om deze investering weg te nemen. De dienst is gebaseerd op een eigen software platform dat op vier manieren helpt bij het inwinnen, verwerken en aanbieden van drone-inzichten:

1. Adviseurs zouden niet moeten hoeven rommelen en experimenteren met camera- en droneinstellingen, vluchtrouts etc. Daarom kan een adviseur bij VanBoven simpelweg aangeven welk perceel hij/zij wilt vliegen. Het platform genereert automatisch de optimale instellingen en vluchtroute en deelt deze over het internet met de drone. De adviseur hoeft enkel de drone aan te zetten en in een app op 'Go' te drukken. De vlucht wordt vervolgens geheel automatisch uitgevoerd.


2. Een drone verzamelt al snel enkele duizenden foto's van een veld. Adviseurs zouden niet door deze berg met data moeten hoeven ploegen op hun computers. Daarom levert VanBoven een compact systeem dat automatisch de foto's van de geheugenkaart van de drone afleest en naar het platform uploadt - geen computer benodigd! Het platform sorteert alle foto's en slaat ze veilig op.

3. Eenmaal op het platform worden de beelden automatisch gecombineerd tot één grote overzichtskaart. Het resultaat is vergelijkbaar met een Google Earth kaart, maar dan kun je inzoomen tot een detailniveau van enkele millimeters. Eventueel kunnen ook indexkaarten (Leaf Area Index, Green Area Index etc) worden berekend.

4. De resultaten zijn binnen 24 uur online te bekijken in een beveiligde omgeving. Adviseurs kunnen hier inloggen, de gewassen inspecteren, aantekeningen maken en de kaarten delen met de klant. Deze omgeving kan als 'white label' worden geleverd, zodat deze volledig integreert met de bestaande website en opmaak.

Met de service van VanBoven kun je als adviseur dronediensten aan je klanten bieden met een minimale investering in training en technologie.

name: Hawk-EyeTM System
title: Hawk-Eye™ Systems, using thermal and visual image data, precisely monitor and measure and report crop health, stress, quality, and guide irrigation.
desc:
Hawk-Eye™ Systems are fully autonomous, 24/7/365, remote sensing and reporting systems that image and measures canopy temperature in the far-IR band and canopy color in the visual band from image data captured and reported every ten minutes, day and night. From the data indices, notices, and enhanced imagery of the crop are available to certified clients in real-time via internet to phones, mobile devices, and desktops. Measurements are processed in real-time to assess and report canopy color, homogeneity, and crop stress; and to provide irrigation guidance. The indices can be formatted to actuate irrigation, fertigation, and precision applications of herbicides, pesticides and other amendments. All the imagery and data are archived for look backs and record keeping.
The Hawk-Eye™ camera set is easily established near the crop to gain a view of the canopy. Camera sets may be mounted on trees, poles, mast mounted trailers, buildings, or any vantage point that has a view of the crop. The associated mobile communications sub-set uses the local cell network to communicate the data from the field to Hawk-Eye™’s cloud. The field unit can be powered by DC or AC power and can be easily relocated when needed.
The Hawk-Eye™ System distills the extremely large amounts of data to provide pertinent and actionable real-time messages from the crop. Use it to scout for early warning of disease, pests, drainage issues, and the impact of cultivation practices.  Use it to prescribe irrigation. It will recommend needed irrigation and can be tuned to provide deficit irrigation guidance.
Measure and listen to what your crop has to say. Save time and make money. Grow quality.
Practice Sustainability.
keywords: thermal and visual image data, canopy color, canopy temperature, agronomic indices, remote sensing, crop maintenance, sustainability, environmental monitoring, irrigation, deficit irrigation, fertigation, field scouting, plant health, field drainage

name: TITRIS
title: The Applied Innovation Research and Results Information System (TITRIS)
titleOther: Taikomųjų inovacijų tyrimų ir rezultatų informacinė sistema (TITRIS)
desc:
The Applied Innovation Research and Results Information System (TITRIS) collects, disseminates, and compiles data on applied innovation research and its results that are useful for more efficient, sustainable, and environmentally friendly farming.
TITRIS focuses on research and innovations developed in practice that have, and can have, a greater or lesser impact on the development of sustainable agricultural production. TITRIS system is designed to provide farmers, advisers, and researchers with access to innovations developed in the field of agriculture. 
Research institutions, farms and other specialised producers contribute data on the results of applied research and innovations to TITRIS.
All data is carefully evaluated by competent specialists of the Lithuanian Agricultural Advisory Service before the innovations are made public in TITRIS. The aim is to assess (determine) the clarity, novelty, applicability, and relevance of the information.
TITRIS is a part of the project “Gate of Innovations – the  centre for knowledge accumulation, transfer, development of agricultural technologies and their demonstration”.

name: Pest monitoring
title: Monitoring of pests of cereals, oilseed rape, field bean and field peas.
desc: The monitoring system provides information on the phytosanitary status of the main crops during the growing season and provides regional recommendations for disease and pest control. Monitoring of pests begins with winter crops in May, spring crops are added in June and ends in July. Weekly route monitoring collect data on the prevalence of pests on most cultivated crops. The observation data is presented operatively as a visualized map as an ArcGIS web application with recommendations on the need to use chemical control. To detect early infection, monitoring involves collecting plant samples from visually healthy fields for the early detection of some fungal pathogens (septoria, ramularia) by PCR assays. During the monitoring, beetles are collected from rapeseed fields and the possible presence of insecticide resistance is analyzed. Cereal samples are collected before and during the harvest to determine the presence of Fusarium fungi and mycotoxins.

name: Calculate carcass growth per kg of feed consumed - Karkasgroei per kg voeder
title: Web tool for pig farmers to calculate carcass growth per kg feed and standardized carcass growth per kg feed.
titleOther: Webtool voor varkenshouders om de karkasgroei per kg voeder en de gestandaardiseerde karkasgroei per kg voeder te berekenen.
desc: The calculation formula is based on two different parameters and corresponding formulas: carcass growth per kg feed and standardised carcass growth per kg feed. Both place weight gain in the counter and feed use in the denominator, in contrast to most existing feed conversion formulas. In this way, the parameters better match conventional productivity parameters, such as labour or capital productivity. In addition, it was decided to work with warm carcass weight instead of live weight, as this is measured by default in Flemish slaughterhouses. Our neighbouring countries and most other European countries also work with warm carcass weight. Carcass growth per kg feed serves as an objective representation of the performance of the fattening pigs in a production round. The standardised carcass growth per kg feed corrects for mortality (using a linear model) and is representative for a weight trajectory of 25-115 kg (live weight). The latter formula makes comparisons between farms much simpler and unambiguous.
descOther: De rekenformule baseert zich op twee verschillende parameters en bijbehorende formules: karkasgroei per kg voeder en gestandaardiseerde karkasgroei per kg voeder. Beide plaatsen gewichtstoename in de teller en voedergebruik in de noemer, in tegenstelling tot de meeste bestaande formules voor voederconversie. Op die manier sluiten de parameters beter aan bij conventionele productiviteitsparameters, zoals arbeids- of kapitaalproductiviteit. Daarenboven werd beslist te werken met warm karkasgewicht i.p.v. levend gewicht, omdat dit standaard wordt gemeten in Vlaamse slachthuizen. Ook onze buurlanden en de meeste andere Europese landen werken met warm karkasgewicht. Karkasgroei per kg voeder dient als een objectieve weergave van de prestaties van de vleesvarkens in een productieronde. De gestandaardiseerde karkasgroei per kg voeder corrigeert voor sterfte (a.d.h.v. een lineair model) en is representatief voor een gewichtstraject van 25-115 kg (levend gewicht). Deze laatste formule maakt dat vergelijkingen tussen bedrijven veel eenvoudiger en eenduidiger zijn.

desc:
The ration tool is a tool for dairy farmers,  with which the ration for lactating dairy cows can be calculated. The tool also contains an extensive list of feed materials with average feed value to simulate rations without their own analysis. 
Farmers can give better rations thank to this tool, and it is often used a controle on what companies that sell food propose as ration. 
Farmers can use it both ways: with a less costly ration, do the cows give the same amount of milk? Or if I want them to give more milk, what effect does this have on the price of the ration? It is also possible to choose to include less protein in the ration, to have less emissions, which is better for the climate.

Boeren kunnen dankzij deze tool betere rantsoenen geven en het wordt vaak gebruikt om te controleren wat bedrijven, die voedsel verkopen, als rantsoen aanbieden. 
Boeren kunnen het op twee manieren gebruiken: geven de koeien met een minder kostbaar rantsoen dezelfde hoeveelheid melk? Of als ik wil dat ze meer melk geven, wat voor effect heeft dit dan op de prijs van het rantsoen? Het is ook mogelijk om te kiezen voor minder eiwit in het rantsoen, om minder uitstoot te hebben, wat beter is voor het klimaat. De ILVO Rantsoentool Melkvee kan gratis gedownload worden vanop de website van het Rundveeloket.

name: e-Exploração
title: Online patform for animal production management
titleOther: Plataforma online para gestão de efectivos pecuários
desc:
e-Exploração is an online platform which enables livestock producers to have a support for the decision making process. 
Keeping accurate data is crucial for producers’ decision making, as it allows them to select the most productive animals (higher weight gains, lower mortality, lower calving interval, more profitable animals), thus obtaining a larger revenue. e-Exploração makes the most out of the registered data, producing a vast amount of reports, fundamental to the daily management.
It has a modular structure, which allows farmers to subscribe only the modules that are going to be usefull.
descOther:
O e-Exploração é uma plataforma online que, para além de gerir a documentação obrigatória dos produtores, é uma ferramenta de apoio à decisão dos gestores de explorações agrícolas.

Sendo uma plataforma online encontra-se acessível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, em qualquer computador com ligação à internet. São garantidas ainda cópias de segurança automáticas, realizadas todos os dias. Estas duas características do e-Exploração (disponibilidade e segurança) são, provavelmente, as que representam a maior evolução relativamente às aplicações anteriormente desenvolvidas.
Neste momento encontra-se em funcionamento o módulo de bovinos (homologado pela DGAV para a substituição do LREDB), o módulo de Registo de Ovinos e Caprinos e o Livro de Medicamentos . Estão também em desenvolvimento novos módulos, de acordo com as necessidades dos produtores, como por exemplo os módulos de gestão de caderno de campo de Produção Integrada e de gestão de parcelas.

Preços em vigor	O e-Exploração insere-se no modelo do "Software as a Service" (SaaS), ou seja, encontra-se instalado em servidores, não sendo necessária qualquer instalação no computador do cliente. Desta forma, ao invés de adquirir um programa informático, cada cliente subscreve um serviço, que é pago consoante o nível de utilização. Saiba como pode aderir.

O acesso ao e-Exploração pode ser feito directamente pelo produtor/proprietário, ou por uma entidade na qual aquele delegue a gestão documental da exploração. Neste segundo caso será sempre possível ao produtor/proprietário aceder ao e-Exploração para consulta da informação. Conheça aqui as entidades que utilizam o e-Exploração para gestão documental de explorações. Cada cliente do e-Exploração poderá gerir uma ou mais explorações.

name: Web Application Potato Disease - Webapplicatie Aardappelziekte
title: The 'web application potato disease' enables you to get a picture at any time of the risk to which your potato parcel is exposed at a specific location and time.
titleOther: De ‘webapplicatie aardappelziekte’ stelt u in staat om op elk moment een beeld te krijgen van het risico waaraan uw perceel op een welbepaalde locatie en tijdstip is blootgesteld.
desc:
The web application potato disease gives you an insight into the relevant, current and location-specific information needed to tackle Phytopthora infestans (= potato disease) in potatoes in a reasoned manner.
➢ Relevant: the underlying database contains many calculations that simulate the development of the disease or the evolution of crop protection. From the large amount of data, only the information that supports the final decision (whether or not to protect) is shown.
➢ Current: every three hours, detailed weather data from a network of 48 weather stations in Flanders are processed in the disease model. Twice a day they are supplemented with hourly forecasts up to 96 hours ahead, per climate region.
➢ Location-based: for each postal code, the closest weather stations are taken into account.
With the 'web application potato disease' you can therefore get a picture at any time of the risk to which your potato parcel is exposed at a specific location and time. In this way, crop protection agents are used in a responsible manner.   The web application is free for PCA members. Anyone can become a member of PCA upon annual payment of the membership fee.
descOther:
De webapplicatie aardappelziekte geeft u een zicht op de relevante, actuele en plaatsgebonden informatie die nodig is om op een beredeneerde manier Phytopthora infestans (= aardappelziekte) in aardappelen aan te pakken.
➢ Relevant: in de achterliggende databank gebeuren heel veel berekeningen die de ontwikkeling van de ziekte of de evolutie van de gewasbescherming simuleren. Uit de grote hoeveelheid data wordt enkel die informatie getoond die de uiteindelijke beslissing (al dan niet beschermen) ondersteunt.
➢ Actueel: om de drie uur worden gedetailleerde weersgegevens, afkomstig van een netwerk van 48 weerstations in Vlaanderen, verwerkt in het ziektemodel. Tweemaal per dag worden ze aangevuld met voorspellingen per uur tot 96 u vooruit, per klimaatregio.
➢ Plaatsgebonden: voor elke postcode wordt rekening gehouden met de meest nabije weerstations
Met de ‘webapplicatie aardappelziekte’ kunt u dus op elk moment een beeld krijgen van het risico waaraan uw aardappelperceel op een welbepaalde locatie en tijdstip is blootgesteld. Zo worden gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op een verantwoorde manier ingezet.
De webapplicatie is gratis voor PCA leden. Iedereen kan lid worden van PCA mits jaarlijkse betaling van het lidmaatschap.

title: SustainFARM Public Goods Tool
desc:
The SustainFARM Public Goods Tool is a sustainability assessment for farmers that combine both food (crops, livestock, vegetables, fruit olives) and non-food (timber and wood fuel) production. 
The assessment takes a broad approach, using information that a farmer would have available to assess the sustainability of their farming system over a 12-month period. Farms are assessed on several areas, referred to as ‘spurs’, that may be impacted by agricultural management practices and are related to public goods such as water quality, air quality, etc.

These spurs are:
- Soil management
- Landscape and heritage
- NPK balance 
- Energy and carbon 
- Food security 
- Agricultural systems diversity 
- Social capital 
- Farm business resilience 
- Animal health and welfare management
- Governance

Each spur is assessed by asking questions based on a number of key “activities”. Answers are scored on a scale between 1 (poor) and 5 (excellent) and an overall score given for each spur. Results are captured on a radar diagram to give an instant visual overview of the sustainability of the farm.

Farmers can also use the tool to investigate the effects of changing or introducing new practices or management to the farm on the sustainability indicators.

title: Biorisk, digital biosecurity to protect your animals
titleOther: Biorisk, bioseguridad digital para proteger a tus animales
desc:
Biorisk is a ground-breaking biosecurity system that aims to stop the spread of diseases on swine farms.

Using an easy system of movement receptors and emitters, Biorisk helps to control potentially dangerous staff movements through the farm so that risky ones that could contribute to the spread of pathogens can be avoided or limited.

HOW BIORISK WORKS

-	Step 1: Our staff use the facility floor plan to identify the optimal locations for movement receptor installations.

-	Step 2: We provide the devices and monitor their installarion through their wireless connections.

-	Step 3: Blood or saliva samples from the animals in each area are tested in the laboratory to establish their health status.

-	Step 4: Based on these results, we classify the areas as healthy or infected.

-	Step 5: We assign an emitter to each worker which allows data about their movements through the facility to be collected as they pass near the movement receptors.

-	Step 6: These data are processed in the cloud and analysed to detect any potentially hazardous behaviours that may spread diseases through the farm. Based on the errors detected, we then carefully coach these workers to help correct any problems identified.

-	Step 7: The system is managed via an app that allows real-time monitoring and generates the analytics required to understand the truth rather than the theory of what happens on the farm. It also generates alerts for immediate actions required to preserve or improve the farm’s health status.

-	Step 8: Biorisk promotes a system of continuous improvement, making the real outcomes of biosecurity protocols visible and allowing the early correction of errors in order to keep the site disease-free.
descOther:
Biorisk es un sistema de bioseguridad innovador que tiene como objetivo detener la propagación de enfermedades en las granjas porcinas.

Mediante un sencillo sistema de receptores y emisores de movimiento, Biorisk ayuda a controlar los movimientos potencialmente peligrosos del personal a través de la granja, de manera que se puedan evitar o limitar aquellos que sean arriesgados y que puedan contribuir a la propagación de patógenos.

CÓMO FUNCIONA BIORISK

- Paso 1: Nuestro personal utiliza el plano de las instalaciones para identificar las ubicaciones óptimas para las instalaciones de los receptores de movimiento.

- Paso 2: Proveemos los dispositivos y monitorizamos su instalación a través de su conexión inalámbrica.

- Paso 3: Se toman muestras de sangre o saliva de los animales en cada área y se analizan en el laboratorio para establecer su estado de salud.

- Paso 4: Basándonos en estos resultados, clasificamos las áreas como sanas o infectadas.

- Paso 5: Asignamos un emisor a cada trabajador lo que permite recoger datos sobre sus movimientos a través de la instalación según pasan cerca de los receptores de movimiento.

- Paso 6: Estos datos se procesan en la nube y se analizan para detectar cualquier comportamiento potencialmente peligroso que pueda propagar enfermedades en la granja. Basándonos en los errores detectados, formamos cuidadosamente a estos trabajadores para ayudar a corregir cualquier problema identificado.

- Paso 7: El sistema se gestiona a través de una aplicación que permite la monitorización en tiempo real y genera los análisis necesarios para comprender lo que realmente está sucediendo en la granja. También genera alertas inmediatas de acciones necesarias para preservar o mejorar el estado de salud de la granja.

- Paso 8: Biorisk promueve un sistema de mejora continua, haciendo visibles los resultados reales de los protocolos de bioseguridad y permitiendo la corrección temprana de errores para mantener el sitio libre de enfermedades.

desc:
PeHeStat stands for Performance and Health Statistics. Our main objective can be deducted from this. Health parameters, house parameters and laboratory results from the industrial poultry sector are collected and analysed. Based on a thorough analysis, PeHeStat can then give individual advice to the poultry farmers.
In order to collect and analyse zootechnical data from farms, we use 2 tools: Porphyrio’s Smart Farm Assistant and Poultrack, our own developed software. PeHeStat distributes the software and takes care of the technical follow-up. Based on the data collected and analysed within Poultrack and Smart Farm Assistant, PeHeStat can provide individual advice to the poultry farmer. The result: a better production process, a healthy poultry herd and a safe end product.
Poultrack® was developed in-house and can be summarised as an online portal where all documents that belong to the mandatory company register are classified. name: iVeg
title: IoT-based Platform for Greenhouse Crop Production
desc:
The cloud architecture used for the development is divided into layers, which allow us to work on the development in a decoupled way. These are divided in the following way: Context Producers, Back-end and Front-end. The main advantage of this architecture is to allow independent developments in each of the layers so that the operation of the previous layer is not affected. 

LAYER 0 - CONTEXT PRODUCERS is responsible for generating all the context information. To generate this information, it is necessary to have physical devices capable of collecting information from the environment. These devices are data acquisition system with sensors and actuators. These IoT devices lack a standard in the data format, and, for this reason, it was decided to use the standard of FIWARE NGSI trying to homogenize the data format. Other of the available context producing systems is the use of weather forecast public service allowing to make consultations in real time, 76 hours in the future and historical data in a determined region. In this way, we provide knowledge of the external climate conditions of the greenhouse without the need to have our own acquisition system in the farm.

Layer 1 – back-end is known as the data access layer or the logical part of any application. It is responsible for performing the heavy tasks of the system. It focuses on performing tasks such as data extraction from layer 0, CRON processes, context information managers, REST API services, language interpreters, databases, control systems, among others. The benefit of having a decoupled Back-end is to allow new developments, avoiding downtime in the rest of the services. In the same way, it allows developing new Front-end clients without affecting the current one. Another benefit is to provide an intermediate security layer in the system. 
The core of the platform is the Greenhouse Model as a Service (GMaaS). This service is based on Matlab Production Server. When a greenhouse is registered in the system, specific models for inside climate, crop production, and irrigation are implemented in the platform as particular services. These model-based services provide the user a DSS tool to obtain forecast about indoor climate conditions, crop production, or irrigation needs, among others.

name: IPM Decisions Platform
title: Decision Support Systems for Integrated Pest Management
desc:
Having accurate and reliable information about pest and disease risk is essential when planning integrated pest management strategies.

The IPM Decisions Platform provides a “one stop shop” for decisions support in integrated pest management. It gives farmers and advisers access to a large range of existing Decision Support Systems for their regional conditions. The platform consists of a web-based framework that provides farmers, advisors and researchers access to a wide range of decision support systems and weather data from across Europe through a set of four dashboards. It provides farmers, advisors and researchers with the ability to assess the reliability and suitability of different decision support systems so they can select those that are most suited to their needs. 

The dashboard provides an “at-a-glance” indication of the risk for pest and diseases across whole farm using a traffic light colour scheme. Farmers and advisors are able to select crops, pests and diseases of interest using a set of drop down menus. The dashboard also includes the ability to set up email or text alerts for each of the pest and diseases.

The dashboard allows farmers and advisors to compare the results from a number of different decision support systems for a given pest or disease, so that they can choose the systems that are right for them.

The IPM Decisions Platform allows access to decision support systems from across Europe. Many of these decisions support systems will have been developed for specific countries. This dashboard allows researchers to modify the parameters within the decision support systems to adapt them for use across a wider range of countries. Researcher are able to compare the outputs before and after modification of the parameters. The dashboard also allows researchers to download the results for comparison with field data for validation and verification purposes.

titleOther: KAP támogatás kalkulátor
desc:
As a result of the reform of the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP), the system of direct payments has changed significantly since 2015. A number of new, mandatory and voluntary elements have been added to the system. The structure of the direct support system set up in accordance with the decisions of the Hungarian Member States is illustrated in the figure below:  You can use the most relevant support calculator of the National Chamber of Agriculture to calculate the expected amount of your direct support (SAPS, greening, support for young farmers, coupled support). Based on the calculated result, you can consider joining the support scheme for small producers, which was introduced as an alternative to the single area payment scheme in 2015, and the support
available under the scheme will replace all direct support.The calculator starts with the data of the farm manager and in the end it will show if the respondent is entitled to the additional support which can be applied for by young farmers. In the Crop Production block, you can enter your important data for the support . 
In the animal husbandry section, you can provide relevant data to livestock support entitlements. 
The calculator also gives you an idea of the expected payments financed from other national sources, which you will be able to use in addition to direct payments in the single area payment scheme and in addition to small producer support in the small producer support system. Without wishing to be exhaustive, the calculator only takes into account subsidies financed from the most typical other national sources of crop and livestock production. 
The grant amounts are estimates. In the case of grants paid from EU funds, the amount of the
grant actually depends on the forint / euro exchange rate set for the payment of the grant, the actual specific grant amount (s) and any deductions. In the case of grants paid from national sources, the amount of grants to be paid depends on the amounts included in the approved national budget.
descOther:
A Nemzeti Agrárgazdasági Kamara aktualizált támogatás kalkulátora segítségével kiszámíthatja a közvetlen támogatásainak várható összegét (SAPS, zöldítés, fiatal mezőgazdasági termelőknek járó támogatás, termeléshez kötött támogatások). name: MePAR
title: Agricultural Parcel Identification System (MePAR)
titleOther: Mezőgazdasági Parcella Azonosító Rendszer (MePAR)
desc:
The Agricultural Parcel Identification System (MePAR) is the exclusive national identification system for land support procedures under Article 67 (2) of Regulation (EU) No 1306/2013. Exclusive in the sense that only data from this identification system can be used when applying for EU funding, in whole or in part, related to land. When applying for such subsidies, the data of any other register (eg the land register) cannot be taken into account against the data of the MePAR, be it the location, identification number or even the area of the agricultural plots. 
Basically, this system is needed because the legislation of the European Union and Hungary stipulates that the subsidies in question are
mandatory. From the 2004 grant year onwards, the MePAR will ensure the clear identification of the location of the agricultural parcels on which 
land are based exactly where and will help to provide a simple and accurate indication of their area. In a GIS system, with the map-based aerial view background, the data required for the application and supporting it are available. 
The MePAR is used by the farms themselves at the time of application and by the agency during the application management and control.
descOther:

Kizárólagos abban az értelemben, hogy a földterülethez kapcsolódó részben vagy egészben európai uniós támogatások igénylése során csak ennek az azonosítási rendszernek az adatait lehet használni. Az ilyen jellegű támogatások igénylésekor semmiféle más nyilvántartás (pl. az ingatlan-nyilvántartás) adatait a MePAR adataival szemben nem lehet figyelembe venni, legyenek azok a mezőgazdasági táblák elhelyezkedésére, azonosító számára, vagy éppen a tábla területére vonatkozó adatok.

titleOther: Managementplan Forst
desc:
Managementplan Forst is an extensive free online-tool for sustainable forest planning. It supports all forest owners and forest managers in Austria.
It fulfills 3 tasks:
1. extended calculation of angle count sampling (Bitterlich) with wood log grading
2. creation of a multifunctional forest management plan based on forest stands
3. visualisation of forest stands with a GIS viewer_
descOther:
Der Managementplan Forst -MPFORST- ist das interaktive Werkzeug zur Erfassung, Planung und Kontrolle von Kennzahlen zur Steuerung des Waldmanagements für eine multifunktionale nachhaltige Waldbewirtschaftung.

MPFORST ist für alle Benutzer kostenfrei verwendbar. 

Auf Basis aktueller wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse und langjähriger praktischer Erfahrungen wurde er erstellt. Er besteht aus drei Teilen, die unabhängig voneinander verwendet oder miteinander kombiniert werden können.

Teil 1 - WZPX
Erweiterte Winkelzählprobenauswertung nach Bronner und Pelzmann

In einem Bestand werden mehrere Winkelzählproben (WZP) mit Ansprache der Baumart und Stückzahl pro Baumart durchgeführt. Von mindestens einer WZP ist dazu von der Hauptbaumart noch das Alter, der Brusthöhendurchmesser (BHD) und die Baumhöhe des Grundflächenzentralstamms, der Kronenansatz und die Wuchsklasse zu erheben.
Die Angabe weiterer Parameter ist möglich, aber nicht unbedingt notwendig, und verbessert die Genauigkeit der Ergebnisse. Sind sie nicht vorhanden, werden mittels verschiedener Substitutionsverfahren die fehlenden Werte qualifiziert geschätzt. Dies gilt u.a. auch für Baumarten, die nur untergeordnet vorkommen.
Das Ergebnis der Auswertung sind mehrschichtige forstliche Kennzahlen und Sortierungen untergliedert nach Sortimenten pro Bestand, Baumart und Wuchsklasse. 


Teil 2 - MFO
Multifunktionales Operat nach Bronner und Pelzmann

Basierend auf bestandesweisen Erhebungen werden Standortsbeschreibungen und Bestandeskennzahlen verarbeitet.
Die ertragskundlichen Daten können durch WZPX-Erhebungen, über Taxation (okulare Schätzung) mittels Ertragstafeln oder durch Dynamische Bonitierung ermittelt werden.
Mit den Konzepten „Reifegrad (Relatives Alter)“, „Nutzungspotentialanalyse nach Waldbauvorgaben“, Berechnungen von Hiebsätzen, Biodiversitätsparameter, dem Kohlenstoffspeicher Wald und der Erhebungsqualität werden die Ergebnisse als Berichte bestandesweise und gesamtbetrieblich aus multifunktionalen Blickwinkeln ausgewertet und dargestellt.


Teil 3 GIS-Viewer und QGIS-Forst
Waldwirtschaftplanung und Landkarten gehören zusammen.

Das Konzept des MPForst sieht aus Kostengründen vor, fertige, bestehende Bestandeskarten in einen GIS Viewer hochladen zu können und zum Orientieren,  Navigieren und Darstellen zu verwenden. Das Bearbeiten der Karten ist nicht vorgesehen.  
Für die Erstellung solcher Karten wird empfohlen QGIS -Forst zu verwenden.
