name: DiseñEN
title: A tool to design ecological infrastructures and to serve as a meeting point for sharing experiences related to conservation biological control
titleOther: Una herramienta para diseñar infraestructuras ecológicas y para servir de punto de encuentro para compartir experiencias relacionadas con el control biológico por conservación
desc:
DiseñEN is an interactive web tool that aims to support decision making for the implementation of conservation biological control strategies and to offer tailor-made solutions. The tool is able to design a hedge made up of native plants adapted to particular conditions based on a few parameters, such as the available space in metres or the location, offering the farmer an optimised design for his/her farm. The selection of the plant species that will make up the hedge is carried out in such a way as to introduce functional biodiversity, which allows the agro-ecosystems to be adapted to the needs of the native beneficial auxiliary fauna and thus promote biological control by conservation.
Anyone, with no need for knowledge of native flora and its auxiliary fauna, can obtain a list of suitable plant species, the number of plants of each species and a planting sketch. 
The website also contains information on native plant species that have desirable attributes to host natural enemies of pests, as well as on auxiliary fauna that can help in pest control, including information not only on arthropods, but also on vertebrates (reptiles, birds and mammals).
descOther:
DiseñEN es una herramienta web interactiva que persigue apoyar la toma de decisiones para la puesta en práctica de estrategias de control biológico por conservación y ofrecer soluciones a la carta. La herramienta es capaz de diseñar un seto formado por plantas autóctonas adaptado a unas condiciones particulares a partir de unos pocos parámetros, como el espacio disponible en metros o la ubicación, ofreciendo al agricultor un diseño optimizado para su explotación agrícola. La selección de las especies vegetales que integrarán el seto se realiza de forma que se introduzca biodiversidad funcional, lo que permite adaptar los agroecosistemas a las necesidades de la fauna auxiliar beneficiosa autóctona y fomentar así el control biológico por conservación.
Cualquier persona, sin necesidad de tener conocimientos sobre flora autóctona y su fauna auxiliar, puede obtener una relación de especies de plantas adecuadas, número de plantas de cada especie y un croquis de plantación 
La web también recoge información sobre especies vegetales autóctonas que presentan atributos deseables para albergar enemigos naturales de las plagas, así como sobre fauna auxiliar que puede ayudar en el control de plagas, recogiendo información no solo de artrópodos, sino también de vertebrados (reptiles, aves y mamíferos).
keywords: Conservation biological control, functional biodiversity, pest, native flora, auxiliary fauna

providerName: Research Institute of Organic Agriculture FiBL
title: SMART is a method that allows farms and companies in the food sector to assess their sustainability in a credible, transparent and comparable manner.
titleOther: SMART ist eine Methode, die es ldw. Betrieben und Unternehmen der Lebensmittelbranche ermöglicht, ihre Nachhaltigkeit glaubwürdig, transparent und vergleichbar zu bewerten.
desc: SMART is an innovative instrument for holistic sustainability analysis and evaluation of agricultural and food companies and is based on the globally valid SAFA guidelines (Sustainability Assessment of Food and Agriculture Systems, FAO 2014). It was developed by more than 60 agricultural and sustainability experts and consists of a highly efficient database as well as a scientifically sound evaluation methodology including an extensive indicator pool. The assessment method involves, among other things, a weighting of the indicators according to the level of impact on the various SAFA subthemes. Furthermore, the sphere of influence and responsibility of the respective farm or company as well as the time, place and responsible party of sustainability impacts within the supply chain are being considered. SMART is not a new standard, certification system or label but solely an analysis and assessment instrument. It therefore does not compete with existing standards and certificates but is a useful supplement. The SMART tool should be implemented by experts, and therefore anyone interested in the tool should contact those responsible for the tool to arrange a training.
descOther: SMART ist ein innovatives Instrument zur ganzheitlichen Nachhaltigkeitsanalyse und -bewertung von Agrar- und Lebensmittelunternehmen und basiert auf den weltweit gültigen SAFA-Richtlinien (Sustainability Assessment of Food and Agriculture Systems, FAO 2014). Es wurde von mehr als 60 Agrar- und Nachhaltigkeitsexperten entwickelt und besteht aus einer hocheffizienten Datenbank sowie einer wissenschaftlich fundierten Bewertungsmethode mit einem umfangreichen Indikatorpool. Die Bewertungsmethode beinhaltet unter anderem eine Gewichtung der Indikatoren nach dem Grad der Auswirkung auf die verschiedenen SAFA-Unterthemen. Darüber hinaus werden der Einflussbereich und die Verantwortung des jeweiligen Betriebes oder Unternehmens für die Auswirkungen auf die Nachhaltigkeit innerhalb der Lieferkette berücksichtigt. SMART ist kein neuer Standard, kein neues Zertifizierungssystem oder Label, sondern ausschließlich ein Analyse- und Bewertungsinstrument. Es konkurriert daher nicht mit bestehenden Standards und Zertifikaten, sondern ist eine nützliche Ergänzung. Das SMART-Tool wird von geschulten Anwender*innen eingesetzt. Daher sollte sich jeder, der an dem Tool interessiert ist, an die für das Tool Verantwortlichen wenden, um an einer Schulung teilnehmen zu können.

name: Monet Viticultura
title: Control of the vineyard state from any Internet connected device
titleOther: Control del estado del viñedo desde cualquier dispositivo conectado a Internet
desc:
Monet Viticultura is a web platform to control the current state of the vineyard and its evolution from any Internet connected device

The tool incorporates algorithms for assessing and predicting the risk of disease in the vineyard (mildew, powdery mildew, botrytis and black rot) and the evolution of phenology. This information allows the viticulturist to anticipate the appearance of the disease and to plan tasks efficiently.

To run the disease and phenology prediction models we need to collect meteorological data from the vineyard, offering three possibilities:
1. Use weather stations that are already installed in the vineyard and adapt them, if possible, to transmit to the server managed by Monet.
2. Use public weather stations close to the vineyard that are representative of its behaviour.
3. Install new weather stations in locations of interest in the vineyard.

The platform also includes vegetation maps obtained through the processing of aerial images gathered from satellites, drones or aircrafts. This information allows the vineyard zoning and the classification of the grapes prior to harvest, information of great interest for effective production management.

Monet Viticultura is completed with a document management system that allows the user to enter information on the tasks carried out in the vineyard and any incident detected in it, integrating, in a single platform, all the information that winegrowers need to carry out their daily work.

The user will receive a daily report on the state of the vineyard by email and will also have a mobile APP available for iOS and Android.
descOther:
Monet Viticultura es una plataforma web que permite controlar el estado actual del viñedo y su evolución desde cualquier dispositivo conectado a Internet. 

La herramienta incorpora algoritmos de valoración y predicción del riesgo de enfermedad en el viñedo (mildiu, oidio, botritis y black rot) y de evolución de fenología. Esta información permite al viticultor adelantarse a la aparición de la enfermedad y planificar tareas de forma eficiente. 

Para ejecutar los modelos de predicción de enfermedades y fenología necesitamos recoger datos meteorológicos del viñedo, ofreciendo tres posibilidades:
1.	Emplear estaciones meteorológicas que ya estén instaladas en el viñedo y adaptarlas, si es posible, para que transmitan al servidor gestionado por Monet.
2.	Emplear estaciones públicas cercanas al viñedo y que sean representativas de su comportamiento.
3.	Instalar nuevas estaciones en las localizaciones de interés del viñedo.

La plataforma también incluye mapas de vegetación del viñedo obtenidos a través del procesado de imágenes aéreas obtenidas de satélites, drones o avionetas. Esta información permite zonificar el viñedo y realizar clasificaciones de uva previas a vendimia, información de gran interés para la gestión eficaz de la producción. 

Monet Viticultura se completa con un sistema de gestión documental que permite al usuario introducir información de los manejos realizados en el viñedo y de cualquier incidencia detectada en él, integrando, en una única plataforma, toda la información que necesita el viticultor para realizar su trabajo diario.

El usuario recibirá un informe diario del estado del viñedo por correo electrónico y dispondrá, adicionalmente, de un APP móvil disponible para iOS y Android.

titleOther: Αέρια θερμοκηπίου, αποτύπωμα νερού και αποβλήτων στις αγροτικές επιχειρήσεις
desc: ROADTool is a web GIS-based app that estimates Greenhouse Gases (GHGs) emissions and water- and waste- footprint at enterprise and at value chain levels. The Tool was developed in the framework of the INTERREG Balkan-Mediterranean project under the title “Towards farms with zero carbon-, waste- and water-footprint. Roadmap for sustainable management strategies for Balkan agricultural sector” and with acronym BalkanROAD (https://balkanroad.eu). The tool estimates the emissions throughout the entire production line of marketable agricultural products, i.e., grapes to wine, olives to olive oil, apples to apple juice, etc, starting from cultivation in the field and ending after packaging and before the market entrance. The user inserts operational data through a user-friendly interface, e.g. fertilizers amount, energy and fuels consumption, water consumption, etc., and receives visualized results.  Moreover, due to its modularity, the ROADtool is easily adjustable to other types of businesses, for example, hotels, storehouses, logistics, etc. Apart from GHGs emissions, the tool estimates the agribusinesses’ water and waste footprint. It is worth noting that the BalkanROAD project which developed the ROADTool was one of the five best projects in Europe in the REGIOSTARS2021 awards in the category SMART EUROPE.
descOther: Το ROADTool είναι μια web GIS εφαρμογή η οποία υπολογίζει τις εκπομπές αερίων θερμοκηπίου (GHG) και το αποτύπωμα νερού και αποβλήτων σε επίπεδο επιχείρησης και σε επίπεδο αλυσίδας αξίας. Το  ROADTool αναπτύχθηκε στο πλαίσιο του έργου INTERREG Balkan-Mediterranean με τίτλο "Αγροκτήματα με μηδενικό αποτύπωμα άνθρακα, αποβλήτων και νερού. Στρατηγικές αειφόρου διαχείρισης για τον αγροτικό τομέα των Βαλκανίων-BalkanROAD" (https://balkanroad.eu). Το εργαλείο υπολογίζει τις εκπομπές αερίων θερμοκηπίου σε ολόκληρη τη γραμμή παραγωγής εμπορεύσιμων γεωργικών προϊόντων, δηλαδή από σταφύλια σε κρασί, από ελιές σε ελαιόλαδο, από μήλα σε χυμό κ.λπ., ξεκινώντας από την καλλιέργεια στο χωράφι έως και μετά τη συσκευασία και την είσοδο στην αγορά. name: PLANET
title: Nutrient management decision support tool encoding official recommendations for UK arable and grassland crops
desc:
There are several modules in PLANET that carry out different calculation, record keeping and reporting functions. 

      Field-level nutrient planning and record keeping. This module provides recommendations for individual fields that mimic industry standard recommendations (Defras Fertiliser Manual (RB209) in England and Wales; SRUC technical notes in Scotland). Fertiliser recommendations are given for all major nutrients and lime, and for most agricultural and horticultural crops. Recommendations take account of the crop nutrient requirement, the soil nitrogen supply, other soil analysis results, and the nutrients supplied from any organic manure applications. A nutrient application plan can be developed and updated during the season. Detailed records can be kept of cropping, soil analyses, and each actual fertiliser and manure application. Reports can be produced.
      The Livestock Manure N Farm Limit. This module calculates the manure N capacity and the manure N loading of both derogated and un-derogated farms. Compliance with the Livestock Manure N Farm Limit is required by all farms within an NVZ.
      Organic manures inventory and the NVZ Minimum manure storage requirement.  The Inventory calculates the quantities of slurry, dirty water, poultry layer manure, poultry litter and other solid manure produced on a farm and their NPK content. The module also calculates the minimum slurry and poultry manure storage requirement of a farm in order to meet the requirements of the NVZ regulations.
      Existing manure storage capacity. This module calculates the capacity of existing slurry, dirty water and solid manure stores.
      The N max limit. This module calculates compliance with the N max limit for individual crop types on the farm, grown on land in an NVZ. Compliance with the N max limit is required by the NVZ regulations.
      Farmgate nutrient balance. This module calculates the balance (i.e. surplus or deficit) of nitrogen, phosphate and potash for the whole farm. The balance results from calculation of nutrients imported onto the farm (e.g. in fertilisers, feedstuffs, organic manures) compared to the nutrients exported off the farm (e.g. in crop and livestock produce, organic manures). For each nutrient, the calculated balance is compared with typical benchmark values for the farm type.

title: Agrecalc is a carbon calculator that measures and benchmarks greenhouse gas emissions of a wide range of agricultural systems.
titleOther: Agrecalc es una calculadora de carbono que mide y compara las emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero de una amplia gama de sistemas agrícolas.
desc:
Agrecalc is a carbon footprint tool developed by SAC Consulting together with SRUC researchers. It enables farm enterprises to identify and measure emissions, benchmark key performance indicators, identify mitigation strategies and monitor improvements.

Our mission and vision is to be one-of-a kind tool for carbon emission calculation, benchmarking and mitigation, enabling the world’s food supply chain to reduce its carbon footprint.

We also support transition to low-carbon agriculture, helping deliver net-zero emissions from food production while increasing the level of both efficiency and farm productivity.

Agrecalc only employs the latest validated scientific methodologies and encourages practical mitigation measures and produces precise carbon footprint reports for all farm enterprises. The coefficients that Agrecalc uses are those of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), the internationally accepted authority on climate change. The IPCC is a part of the United Nations (UN) that was established in 1988 and was presented with a Nobel Peace Prize in 2007.

Developed within Scotland's Rural College (SRUC), a world-renowned institution providing sector-leading research, education and consultancy focused on rural, environmental and land-based activities, the carbon calculation tool combines more than 100 years of agricultural science, and more than 15 years of practical farming experience, delivered by SAC Consulting, the commercial arm that supports and advises land-based businesses in the rural economy to optimise agricultural outcomes and supply chains, always in balance with the environment and in line with national agricultural policy.

Agrecalc is also accredited to PAS:2050 standard: Greenhouse Gas Emissions of Products (PAS 2050:2011) is an independent and widely recognised standard providing requirements and guidelines on specific issues relevant for carbon footprints, including land-use change, carbon uptake, biogenic carbon emissions, soil carbon change, and green electricity.

The platform allows the user to run, compare and simulate scenarios to understand the impact of on-farm changes and monitor progress. The data the user gets back from Agrecalc reports allows them to identify the areas where they can take practical action to reduce their carbon foot print and boost the resource efficiency of their business.

The new version of the platform, with an improved interface and user experience is expected by the end of 2022.

La calculadora permite a las empresas agrícolas identificar y medir las emisiones, comparar indicadores clave de rendimiento, identificar estrategias de mitigación y monitorear mejoras.
Nuestra misión y visión es ser una herramienta única para el cálculo, la evaluación comparativa y la mitigación de las emisiones de carbono, lo que permite a la cadena de suministro de alimentos del mundo reducir su huella de carbono.
La nueva versión de la plataforma, con una interfaz mejorada y una experiencia de usuario, se espera para finales de 2022

desc:
Exceptional weather events affecting crops have become more frequent and varied in recent years. The éPILOTE tool aims to help wheat producers optimize their nitrogen fertilization and irrigation.
This Decision Support tool is based on a crop model coupled with remote sensing data in order to follow the wheat state during the cropping season. With the web app, the farmer automatically receives an alert which advises him about the state of his fields and the necessity to perform a technical operation.

foliaire issues de satellites), afin de suivre l'état du blé pendant la saison culturale.

name: Klimrek climate scan - Klimrek klimaatscan
title: The climate scan is a company-specific screening tool, revealing where the focal points of the company's climate impact lie.
titleOther: De klimaatscan is een bedrijfsspecifieke doorlichtingstool, die duidelijk maakt waar de zwaartepunten in de klimaatimpact van het bedrijf liggen.
desc:
Klimrek is a VLAIO agriculture project in which ILVO, Boerenbond and VITO work together on a climate trajectory for dairy farmers, pig farmers, and arable farmers with potatoes in the cropping plan.
To this end, a climate consultant 'goes out on the farm' with a targeted climate scan and climate course to support farmers in switching to a more climate-friendly and climate-robust business management, also taking into account practical and economic feasibility.
A climate scan based on a life-cycle analysis (LCA) is developed per sector, with which the climate consultant visits the farmer to collect the necessary data.
That climate scan is a company-specific screening tool, which makes clear where the focal points in the company's climate impact lie. With that insight, the consultant can select climate measures tailored to the farm. The consultant then visits the company to present and discuss these measures with calculated scenarios. At the same time, a cost-benefit analysis is drawn up to estimate the economic feasibility.
descOther:
Klimrek is een VLAIO-landbouwtraject waarin ILVO, Boerenbond en VITO samenwerken aan een klimaattraject voor melkveehouders, varkenshouders, en akkerbouwers met aardappelen in het teeltplan.
Hiervoor gaat een klimaatconsulent 'de boer op' met een gerichte klimaatscan en klimaatkoers om de landbouwers te ondersteunen bij het overstappen naar een meer klimaatvriendelijke en klimaatrobuuste bedrijfsvoering waarbij ook praktische en economische haalbaarheid in rekening worden gebracht.
Per sector wordt een klimaatscan op basis van een levenscyclusanalyse (LCA) ontwikkeld, waarmee de klimaatconsulent bij de landbouwer langsgaat om de nodige data te verzamelen.
Die klimaatscan is een bedrijfsspecifieke doorlichtingstool, die duidelijk maakt waar de zwaartepunten in de klimaatimpact van het bedrijf liggen. Met dat inzicht kan de consulent klimaatmaatregelen op maat van het bedrijf selecteren. Vervolgens komt de consulent langs om deze maatregelen met doorgerekende scenario’s voor te stellen en te bespreken. Tegelijk wordt een kosten-batenanalyse opgemaakt om ook de economische haalbaarheid in te schatten.

title: The "Agroforestry Planner" helps farmers, advisers and other applicators draw up a concrete plan for the layout of an agroforestry (forest agriculture) land.
titleOther: De "Agroforestry Planner" helpt landbouwers, adviseurs en andere toepassers bij het opmaken van een concreet plan voor de inrichting van een agroforestry (boslandbouw) perceel.
desc: Agroforestry or forest agriculture is an integrated land use management where trees or shrubs are combined with an agricultural crop or livestock on the same land. In a well-functioning agroforestry system, both components have a neutral or positive influence on each other, and negative interactions are avoided as much as possible through a well-thought-out design. Agroforestry can also provide ecosystem services such as carbon sequestration, shade for livestock or air purification. The Agroforestry Planner guides you step by step in drawing up a plan for planting trees and/or shrubs on your plot. In the first steps, you enter information about your farm, the plot you have in mind, the desired type of agroforestry (trees + grassland or trees + arable or horticulture) and the objectives you want to achieve by planting trees and/or shrubs. You can then plan the spatial arrangement of trees and/or shrubs on your plot and choose an appropriate tree species. The Tree Selection Matrix guides you through that selection in 4 steps, also taking into account the information already entered. Finally, based on the data entered, a summary report is generated which, depending on your choices, also provides specific advice and feedback.
descOther: Agroforestry of boslandbouw is een landbouwsysteem waar bomen of struiken gecombineerd worden met een landbouwgewas of landbouwdieren op eenzelfde perceel. Bij een goed werkend agroforestrysysteem hebben beide componenten een neutrale of positieve invloed op elkaar, en worden negatieve interacties zoveel mogelijk vermeden door een weldoordacht ontwerp. Agroforestry kan daarnaast ook ecosysteemdiensten leveren zoals koolstofopslag, schaduw voor vee of luchtzuivering. De Agroforestry Planner begeleidt u stapsgewijs bij de opmaak van een plan voor aanplant van bomen en/of struiken op uw perceel. In de eerste stappen geeft u informatie in over uw bedrijf, het perceel dat u in gedachten heeft, het gewenste type agroforestry (bomen + grasland of bomen + akker- of tuinbouw) en de doelstellingen die u wilt bereiken met het aanplanten van bomen en/of struiken. Vervolgens kan u de ruimtelijke schikking van de bomen en/of struiken op uw perceel inplannen en een gepaste boomsoortenkeuze maken. De Boomkeuze Matrix begeleidt u in 4 stappen bij die selectie, ook rekening houdend met de reeds ingegeven informatie. Op basis van de ingevulde gegevens wordt ten slotte een samenvattend rapport aangemaakt waarin naargelang uw keuzes ook gericht advies en feedback gegeven wordt.

name: DigiCompost
title: Digitising organic compost production
desc:
Organic compost is a nutrient-dense, cost-efficient natural fertiliser which supports soil regeneration and the increase of soil organic matter. In Greece and many other countries in the region, due to cost limitations and/or lack of digital skills, the manufacturing of compost, which is taking place in open space piles, is mainly manual. This includes both the monitoring of the compost conditions, which is limited to manual daily checks of the pile’s temperature, but also the decision making and management process, including compost irrigation and stirring activities. 
DigiCompost is a solution that digitises the overall production process, offering extensive supervision, control and optimisation over it along with prediction capabilities on the compost’s nutrients and time of completion. DigiCompost solutions integrates a number of state-of-the-art yet mature technologies: Sensors monitoring the compost pile’s conditions (Temperature, Moisture, pH, O2), IoT technologies for data collection and persistence (wrapped around LoRaWAN), Data analytics (including Machine Learning and AI that allow the identification of correlations among monitored parameters and compost process/outcomes) and Smart Modeling that supports the decision making for automated actuation (compost sprinkler activation when temperature and humidity are above/below a threshold) or dynamic notifications for actions (e.g. usage of compost turner to aerate the compost). DigiCompost supports the concurrent management of multiple piles of large volumes of heterogeneous organic raw materials that are composted in open spaces. At the same time relevant restrictions are being considered are to keep the environmental footprint, the financial investment cost and overall nuisance level to minimum. In order to monitor critical metrics in the field, i.e. parameters related to compost conditions, a technical infrastructure which incorporates and combines sensor devices for recording metrics, RF network for data transmission and a light IT infrastructure for data persistent storage and visualisation, is being used.
keywords: compost, organic, circular economy

name: AGRODATO
cost: Free basic version and premium fee-based version
title: Engineering Technological Services for smart farming based on Sensor’s data, Remote Sensing and Analytics, all integrated in a single software for an optimized crop management.
titleOther: Servicios tecnológicos de ingeniería para agricultura de precisión basados en Teledetección, Sensórica y Analítica, integrado en software único para gestión optimizada de cultivos
desc:
Agrodato is based on three pillars: Remote Sensing, Sensor´s data & targeted Analytics.

AGRICULTURAL REMOTE SENSING
By generation of vegetation indexes from satellite & high-resolution UAV images, we have information of photosynthetic, nutritional, hydric and health status of the crop, information that the naked eye is unable to see. This information is highly useful for crop assessments and improves decision-making.

MONITORING BY SENSORS
Implementation of weather stations, soil probes, dendrometers and real-time weighing devices, among others, to measure parameters of high agronomic value such as humidity, temperature, rainfall, wind, etc. The sensors network is located in pre-selected points following representativeness and variability criteria within the crops. Data is collected in the Software for real-time monitoring and representation.

DATA ANALYSIS & PROCESSING
Targeted and georeferenced sampling of soil, fruit, pests, leaf, etc. is made in the crop and extrapolated to the whole farm.
With the integrated processing of multisource data, we achieve a complete technical-scientific diagnosis of the global state of the crop.

AGRODATO´s workflow:
1.Data collection along the full crop productive cycle; study of photosynthetic activity using multispectral camera; chemical and biological analysis in the lab or through sensors on site.
2.Application of Artificial Intelligence for data processing. Algorithms development and cutting-edge data processing systems.
2.Technical advisory and action plans implementation through output interpretation.

Following this process AGRODATO offers integral service making information accessible to all professionals involved in agricultural production and responsible for optimization of agricultural holdings.

Developments are based on previous digitalization, zonation and thorough study of farms. Following works and reports are created:
Digital Field notebook (agricultural operations management)
Crop characterization: vegetative canopy, vigor (NDVI, LAI, ...)
Maps & graphics for easy data integration & visualization
Fertilization & irrigation plans (eco-sustainable)
Yield & crop quality estimations
Phytopathology alerts

This powerful tool operates in all type of crops: linear, discontinuous and extensive crops and highly improves crop management to farmers having the benefits of high technification, production increase, efficient use of resources, sustainability, adapted to customer and early cost effectiveness.
descOther:
Agrodato se basa en tres pilares: Teledetección, Sensórica y Analítica.

TELEDETECCIÓN AGRÍCOLA
Generación de índices de vegetación a partir de imágenes satelitales y de alta resolución de drones, para conocer el estado fotosintético, nutricional, hídrico y sanitario del cultivo, que a simple vista no es posible captar. Esta información permite evaluar el cultivo y mejora la toma de decisiones.

MONITOREO POR SENSORES
Implementación de estaciones meteorológicas y sensores de planta y suelo para medir parámetros de alto valor agronómico: humedad, temperatura, lluvia, viento, etc. La red de sensores se ubica en puntos predeterminados siguiendo criterios de representatividad y variabilidad dentro de los cultivos. desc:
The aim of the simulator is educational and it provides a test environment to check the behavior of a crop or a virtual plot relationed to a specific irrigation schedule. It is possible to define parameters like the weather, the soil type and the irrigation system for the virtual plot and it allows the configuration of different irrigation strategies for the schedule.
Once the plot and the schedule have been defined, the theorical results can be simulated and displayed in a graphical way where users can compare their results with the results obtained by an expert.Thanks to the data comparison between user and expert results, users are able to learn better irrigation techniques.
descOther:
L’objectiu d’aquest simulador és pedagògic. El simulador ofereix un entorn de proves per poder comprovar el comportament d’un cultiu o parcel•la virtual a una determinada programació de reg. I en el programador de reg es poden configurar les estratègies de reg que l’usuari consideri apropiades, tal i com si es tractés d’un programador de reg convencional.

D’aquesta manera mitjançant la comparació i l’anàlisi de les dades presentades es poden aprendre millors pràctiques de reg.

Vision

titleOther: Servicios tecnológicos de ingeniería para agricultura de precisión basados en Teledetección, Sensórica y Analítica, integrado en software único para gestión optimizada de cultivos
desc:
Agrodato is based on three pillars: Remote Sensing, Sensor´s data & targeted Analytics.

AGRICULTURAL REMOTE SENSING
By generation of vegetation indexes from satellite & high-resolution UAV images, we have information of photosynthetic, nutritional, hydric and health status of the crop, information that the naked eye is unable to see. This information is highly useful for crop assessments and improves decision-making.

MONITORING BY SENSORS
Implementation of weather stations, soil probes, dendrometers and real-time weighing devices, among others, to measure parameters of high agronomic value such as humidity, temperature, rainfall, wind, etc. The sensors network is located in pre-selected points following representativeness and variability criteria within the crops. Data is collected in the Software for real-time monitoring and representation.

DATA ANALYSIS & PROCESSING
Targeted and georeferenced sampling of soil, fruit, pests, leaf, etc. is made in the crop and extrapolated to the whole farm.
With the integrated processing of multisource data, we achieve a complete technical-scientific diagnosis of the global state of the crop.

AGRODATO´s workflow is as follows:
- Data collection along the full crop productive cycle; study of photosynthetic activity using multispectral camera; chemical and biological analysis in the lab or through sensors on site.
- Application of Artificial Intelligence for data processing. Algorithms development and cutting-edge data processing systems.
- Technical advisory and action plans implementation through output interpretation.

Following this process AGRODATO offers integral service making information accessible to all professionals involved in agricultural production and responsible for optimization of agricultural holdings.

Developments are based on previous digitalization, zonation and thorough study of farms. Following works and reports are created:
•	Digital Field notebook (agricultural operations management)
•	Crop characterization: vegetative canopy, vigor (NDVI, LAI, ...)
•	Maps & graphics for easy data integration & visualization
•	Fertilization & irrigation plans (eco-sustainable)
•	Yield & crop quality estimations
•	Phytopathology alerts

This powerful tool operates in all type of crops: linear, discontinuous and extensive crops and highly improves crop management to farmers having the benefits of high technification, production increase, efficient use of resources, sustainability, adapted to customer and early cost effectiveness.

name: MARK-online
title: Nutrient Management tool for farmers and advisors
desc:
Danish farmers` owned company SEGES developed a
nutrient management tool which is able to address current challenges in nutrient
management (Mark Online). Development, maintenance and refining of the tool has
been completely covered by software license fees without notable financial
government support. Because of the private ownership of the tool, there have been
no farmers’ concern that the data fed into Mark Online could be used for other
purposes than nutrient management planning.
Farm advisors were the key actors in spreading knowledge about the tool and
implementing it in practice. Every advisor received intensive trainings by the tool
developers and was supported by adequate information material such as detailed
manuals.
The use of the tool has became mandatory since the Denmark imposed
additional taxes on nitrogen fertilisers for farms which did not apply a sophisticated
nutrient management tool. Currently, about 2.6 million ha in Denmark is being
planned with Mark Online, either by the farmers themselves or by advisors on behalf
of the farmers.

title: A tool for Water and Field Management and Water and Carbon Footprint Estimation
desc:
CypruSaves is a web GIS based platform that offers services to farmers and agricultural processing companies. For the moment provides service for the wine sector of Cyprus. Is a tailored made tool, easily conformed to other crop types and locations.
Its specificity is based on the use of specific crop growing parameters, field soil properties and local climatic data, which in turn provide consultancy of higher reliability and accuracy. Raw data used for the consultancy is downstreamed at vine variety level.
For the moment, the CypruSaves platform offers the following services for 14 vine varieties growing in Cyprus:
1. Estimation of the Water Footprint of the cultivation and of the processing plant. All three components of the Water Footprint, i.e., Blue, Green, and Grey, are calculated.
2. Definition of irrigation needs
3. Definition of parasitic diseases outbreak in relation to climatic conditions
4. Fertilization recommendations based on crop needs and soil properties
5. Calculation of the carbon footprint and the emission of Greenhouse gases (GHG) of the cultivation and the processing unit (wineries).
6. Evaluation of the suitability of an area for the establishment of cultivation (currently vine) according to the climate and soil properties.

name: Best bull selection for insemination - Insemineer met het juiste rietje
title: The dairy tool ‘Best bull selection for insemination' aims to support dairy farmers in making their on-farm insemination strategy.
titleOther: De melkveetool ‘Insemineer met het juiste rietje’ heeft tot doel de melkveehouders te ondersteunen bij het maken van hun inseminatiestrategie op het bedrijf.
desc:
The tool ‘Best bull selection for insemination' was created by Boerenbond and ILVO. This was done in consultation with a group of dairy farmers united in an Operational Group supported by the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development. The aim of the tool is to help dairy farmers decide which insemination strategy to use on their farms.
Through the tool, it shows in a simple way what the additional yield can be if a dairy farmer uses sexed semen and use crosses.
After the farmer enters the specific figures for his farm in the farm variables tab, he can enter the sales prices he is paid in the market parameters tab. The purchase prices of the different types of semen are also set here.
Based on these parameters, a suggested optimum is displayed. First, the required number of calving heifers and the number of heifer calves to be kept for rearing are displayed.
Below that, the farmer finds three predefined scenarios with different shares of sexed heifers, sexed cows and crossbreds. He can adjust the percentages himself by playing with the sliders within each scenario.
Below the different scenarios, the results the farmer will achieve in each composition are visually displayed. By playing with the sliders, the farmer can thus see which combination gives him the best balance and can easily compare different combinations.
descOther:
De tool 'Insemineer met het juiste rietje' is gemaakt door Boerenbond en ILVO. Dit gebeurde in samenspraak met een groep melkveehouders, verenigd in een Operationele Groep die ondersteund wordt door het Europees landbouwfonds voor Plattelandsontwikkeling. Het doel van de tool is om melkveehouders te helpen bij het bepalen van de inseminatiestrategie die ze willen gebruiken op hun bedrijf.
Via de tool wordt op een eenvoudige wijze aangetoond wat de meeropbrengst kan zijn als een melkveehouder gebruik maakt van gesekst sperma en gebruikskruisingen.
Nadat de boer de specifieke cijfers voor zijn bedrijf heeft ingegeven in het tabblad bedrijfsvariabelen, kan hij in het tabblad marktparameters de verkoopprijzen ingeven die hij uitbetaald krijgt. Ook de aankoopprijzen van de verschillende types rietjes worden hier vastgelegd.
Op basis van deze parameters wordt een gesuggereerd optimum weergegeven. Eerst wordt het benodigd aantal kalvende vaarzen en het aantal aan te houden vaarskalveren voor opfok weergegeven.

name: When is my cow no longer profitable ? - Wanneer is mijn koe niet meer rendabel?
title: The tool aims to help dairy farmers make decisions as part of their replacement strategy.
titleOther: De tool heeft tot doel de melkveehouders te ondersteunen bij het nemen van beslissingen in het kader van hun vervangingsstrategie.
desc:
The tool 'When is my cow no longer profitable' was created by Boerenbond and ILVO. This was done as part of an Operational Group with dairy farmers and with support from the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development.

The tool aims to help dairy farmers make decisions as part of their replacement strategy. It calculates in a simple way the minimum amount a reformed cow still needs to produce to get out of cost.

In this tool, this is simulated for 2 possible situations: either there is a heifer ready on the farm to replace the reformed cow (= situation 1) or there is no heifer ready (= situation 2). The calculation takes into account the main cost items (ration, manure outlet and labour) and the possible extra meat value.
descOther:
De tool ’Wanneer is mijn koe niet meer rendabel’ is gemaakt door Boerenbond en ILVO. Dit gebeurde in het kader van een Operationele Groep met melkveehouders en met steun van het Europees landbouwfonds voor Plattelandsontwikkeling.

Deze tool heeft tot doel de melkveehouders te ondersteunen bij het nemen van beslissingen in het kader van hun vervangingsstrategie. Er wordt op een eenvoudige wijze berekend hoeveel een reforme koe nog minimaal moet produceren om uit de kosten te geraken. 
In deze tool wordt dit gesimuleerd voor 2 mogelijke situaties: ofwel staat er een vaars klaar op het bedrijf om de reforme koe te vervangen (= situatie 1) ofwel staat er geen vaars klaar (= situatie 2). Bij de berekening wordt rekening gehouden met de belangrijkste kostenposten (rantsoen, mestafzet en arbeid) en de mogelijke extra vleeswaarde.

name: DjustConnect
providerName: ILVO (Flanders Research Institute for Agriculture, Fisheries and Food)
title: Data sharing platform. DjustConnect provides a digital infrastructure for safe data transport.
titleOther: datadeelplatform. DjustConnect biedt een digitale infrastructuur voor veilig datatransport.
desc:
Imagine it as a highway, with on-ramps for data providers and off-ramps for data receivers. At each on-ramp there’s a barrier operated by the farmer. Only when they open the barrier DjustConnect delivers the requested data package to the correct receiver. We don’t open the package and guarantee safe transport from start to finish. 
Someone has an idea for a new app or tool and is looking for data to develop this. In the ConnectShop from DjustConnect they can view the different data sources on offer and register as data receiver. They choose the data they need and with a click their application will end up with the data provider.
The data provider approves the idea. Using the DjustConnect dashboard they give permission for the use of their data by the data receiver. This seals the deal legally as well. However, the farmer will need to give permission before the data is transported. 
The farmer reviews the data request in their personal DjustConnect dashboard. If they agree, the data transport starts. The farmer can stop this transport at any time with one click in his dashboard.
The new app or tool is ready. The app combines the data in a smart way. This improves the advice the app user gets or helps to ease the burden of administration.
descOther:
Stel het je voor als een snelweg, met opritten voor data-aanbieders en afritten voor data-afnemers. Bij elke oprit staat een slagboom die wordt bediend door de boer. Alleen als zij de slagboom openen, levert DjustConnect het gevraagde datapakket af bij de juiste afnemer. Wij openen het pakket niet en garanderen een veilig transport van begin tot eind. 
Iemand heeft een idee voor een nieuwe app of tool en is op zoek naar data om deze te ontwikkelen. In de ConnectShop van DjustConnect kunnen zij de verschillende databronnen bekijken en zich registreren als data-afnemers. Ze kiezen de data die ze nodig hebben en met een klik komt hun applicatie bij de data-aanbieder terecht.
De data-aanbieder keurt het idee goed. Via het DjustConnect dashboard geven zij toestemming voor het gebruik van hun gegevens door de data-afnemer. Hiermee is de deal ook juridisch rond. De boer moet echter nog wel toestemming geven voordat de gegevens worden getransporteerd. 
De boer bekijkt de data-aanvraag in zijn persoonlijke DjustConnect dashboard. Als hij akkoord gaat, start het datatransport. De boer kan dit transport op elk moment stoppen met één klik in zijn dashboard.
De nieuwe app of tool is klaar. De app combineert de gegevens op een slimme manier. Dit verbetert het advies dat de app-gebruiker krijgt of helpt de administratieve last te verlichten.
keywords: data sharing, data economy, API, platform

title: The information generated in the weekly Hydrological Bulletin will be able to be viewed through a dashboard-type application
titleOther: La información generada en el Boletín Hidrológico Semanal, se va poder contemplar a través de una aplicación tipo cuadro de mando (dashboard).
desc:
The information will be available in a more visual, simple and understandable way, divided into 7 tabs that can be selected at the bottom. In the first 4 you can consult the data of:

- Water reserve: weekly data on the state of peninsular reservoirs larger than 5 hm3.
- Energy: the energy stored in a certain reservoir, the result of the sum of its own energy and repercussion energy.
- Average weekly flows: data on average weekly flows at the gauging stations in the main rivers included in the Hydrological Bulletin.
- Weekly accumulated rainfall: weekly accumulated rainfall data for the current year in a selection of automatic rainfall stations from the Hydrological Bulletin (AEMET data).

Additionally, there are 3 more tabs:
- Help: information about the application and help for data consultation
- Notices: current notices and incidents on the Bulletin data are displayed.
- Contact: shows the way to contact in case of doubts, suggestions or information.
descOther:
Se va a disponer de la información de una manera más visual, sencilla y comprensible, dividida  en 7 pestañas que se pueden seleccionar en la parte inferior. En las 4 primeras se pueden consultar los datos de:
- Reserva hídrica: datos semanales del estado de los embalses peninsulares mayores a 5 hm3.
- Energía: la energía almacenada en un determinado embalse, resultado de la suma de la energía propia y energía de repercusión.
- Caudales medios semanales: datos de caudales medios semanales en las estaciones de aforos en los principales ríos presentes en el Boletín Hidrológico.
- Pluviometría acumulada semanal: datos de pluviometría acumulada semanal del año actual en una selección de estaciones pluviométricas automáticas del Boletín Hidrológico (datos de AEMET).

Adicionalmente, se disponen 3 pestañas más:

- Ayuda: información sobre la aplicación y ayuda para la consulta de datos
- Avisos: se muestran los avisos e incidencias vigentes sobre los datos del Boletín.
- Contacto: se muestra la forma de contactar en caso de dudas, sugerencias o información.

desc:
The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food understands that a significant effort must be made so that companies in the agricultural, fishing and food sectors, agricultural organizations and socio-economic agents in rural areas are equipped with well-trained people who promote a efficient relationship with the centers that generate knowledge.

The variety of our agriculture, our fishing system and our agri-food activity contain and can generate, if adequately supported by knowledge centers, a volume of information and a first-rate technological arsenal.

It is necessary that the knowledge generating centers orient their activity to satisfy the demand for this knowledge, formulated by the companies and the social agents of the rural environment.

These reflections motivated the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food to develop the "Knowledge Platform for the rural and fishing environment" as a tool to "serve knowledge", which will undoubtedly promote the development of our own technological system.

Knowledge about the rural environment must also flow to the rest of society, mostly urban. We must not miss the opportunity to contribute to shaping the paradigms that are decisively installed in society and that, to a large extent, condition the future of our agriculture, our fishing system and our agri-food system.
descOther:
El Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación entiende que se debe de realizar un esfuerzo importante para que las empresas de los sectores agrario, pesquero y alimentario, las organizaciones agrarias y los agentes socioeconómicos del medio rural, se doten de personas bien formadas que impulsen una relación eficiente con los centros que generan el conocimiento.

La variedad de nuestra agricultura, de nuestro sistema pesquero y de nuestra actividad agroalimentaria contienen y pueden generar, si están apoyados adecuadamente por los centros de conocimiento, un volumen de información y un arsenal tecnológico de primera magnitud.

Es necesario que los centros generadores de conocimiento orienten su actividad para satisfacer la demanda de este conocimiento, formulada por las empresas y los agentes sociales del medio rural.

Estas reflexiones motivaron al Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación a desarrollar la "Plataforma de conocimiento para el medio rural y pesquero"como herramienta para "servir conocimiento", lo que sin duda impulsará el desarrollo de nuestro propio sistema tecnológico.

El conocimiento sobre el medio rural debe fluir también hacia el resto de la sociedad, mayoritariamente urbana. No debemos perder la ocasión de contribuir con ello a conformar los paradigmas que se instalan de manera determinante en la sociedad y que, en buena medida, condicionan el futuro de nuestra agricultura, de nuestro sistema pesquero y de nuestro sistema agroalimentario.

name: VitiGEOSS platform - Intelligent services for smart vineyard management
title: Innovative vineyard management platform
desc:
Innovative vineyard management platform providing forecasts, estimations, and recommendations for winemakers to help boost vineyards’ sustainability and adaptation to climate change. The platform offers tools for supporting farmers and business managers to improve their decision-making processes, and, thus, the optimisation of vineyard operations. 

The intelligent services offered combine the Internet of Things, Earth Observation services, sensors, mathematics, and Artificial Intelligence to provide winemakers with complete information about climate, phenology, plant physiology, and disease forecasts, as well as management recommendations for their business operations. 

The platform comprises a wide range of digital decision-support services for viticulture, including weather, sub-seasonal and seasonal climate predictions, and a service that offers monitoring and forecasting of vineyards’ phenology. This service utilizes satellite and in-field observations to better plan and organize the management of the vineyard. 

The system is also prepared to provide useful information on actual crop water consumption and actual biomass production of grapevines, among other vegetative variables. Through this service, farmers can receive water consumption demand and yield estimates for the upcoming season. Other services available in the platform comprise a service that provides predictions of the risk of downy and powdery mildew infections, as well as suggested treatment recommendations to be applied, adjusted to the risk level.

The VitiGEOSS platform also aims to reduce exploitation costs and the environmental impact of operations in the wine sector. In that regard, a business management service has been developed to manage field tasks, such as harvesting, taking into consideration the economic costs, environmental impact, and the timing available.

name: CropManager
title: CropManager is for integrated nutrient management and all other relevant tasks for professional crop management.
desc:
General description
CropManager is available online from the web address https://www.cropmanager.eu. The tool is with a dynamic layout optimised for use and installation as an individual app on all devices, independent of screen resolutions. The app includes the following elements:

Enterprise level
•	Management of livestock manures and other organic fertilisers, include nutrient accounting and budgeting, sales and purchases.
•	Registration of chemicals purchases.
•	Printing of a variety of reports, including printouts with the main aim of supporting crop management, and printouts to serve as documentation to authorities. All printouts are available in PDF formats, and a few also in EXCEL format.

Production site level
•	Soil analyses can be registered with various parameters, including geographical coordinates.
•	Planning of crop rotation, use of seeds, irrigation, fertilisation, and crop protection.
•	The actual performed field operations, such as sowing, field spreading of fertilisers, harvesting etc. can be registered for use as documentation, for internal management and for making economic accounting after the crop production year.

Normative standards 
These includes crop standards, varieties, organic fertilisers, mineral fertilisers, plant protection products, and operations. Users can see other users’ normative standards in an anonymised form and copy these for own use, possibly after editing to make the specific standard relevant for the enterprise in question, for instance concerning the price. 

General
App settings includes:
•	Country affiliation of normative standards.
•	Area unit – ha, sqm., decar, etc.
•	Fertilisation strategy, either a maintenance or a sufficiency strategy
CropManager works with “admin users”, to which member businesses are registered. An admin user can register an unlimited number of enterprises, and invite an unlimited number of “normal” users for sharing access their data in CropManager. 

CropManager is prepared for users’ ability to import or manually register data from public registers, such as Integrated Administration and Control System (IACS) data, including data from the Land Parcel Identification System (LPIS) and the Herd and Animal Register, in order for CropManager to work on the basis of this information and be compliant with FaST (Farm Sustainability Tool) principles, and use the same data as basis as is used by the official control bodies.

Read more details in the attached Technical Documentation.

name: SMART- Sustainability Monitoring and Assessment RouTine (SMART-Farm | SMART-Company)
providerName: Research Institute of Organic Agriculture FiBL
title: SMART is a method that allows farms (SMART-Farm Tool) and companies (SMART-Company Tool) in the food sector to assess their sustainability in a credible, transparent and comparable manner.
titleOther: SMART ist eine Methode, die es ldw. Betrieben und Unternehmen der Lebensmittelbranche ermöglicht, ihre Nachhaltigkeit glaubwürdig, transparent und vergleichbar zu bewerten.
desc: SMART is an innovative instrument for holistic sustainability analysis and evaluation of agricultural and food companies and is based on the globally valid SAFA guidelines (Sustainability Assessment of Food and Agriculture Systems, FAO 2014). It was developed by more than 60 agricultural and sustainability experts and consists of a highly efficient database as well as a scientifically sound evaluation methodology including an extensive indicator pool. The assessment method involves, among other things, a weighting of the indicators according to the level of impact on the various SAFA subthemes. Furthermore, the sphere of influence and responsibility of the respective farm or company as well as the time, place and responsible party of sustainability impacts within the supply chain are being considered. SMART is not a new standard, certification system or label but solely an analysis and assessment instrument. It therefore does not compete with existing standards and certificates but is a useful supplement. The SMART tool should be implemented by experts, and therefore anyone interested in the tool should contact those responsible for the tool to arrange a training.
descOther: SMART ist ein innovatives Instrument zur ganzheitlichen Nachhaltigkeitsanalyse und -bewertung von Agrar- und Lebensmittelunternehmen und basiert auf den weltweit gültigen SAFA-Richtlinien (Sustainability Assessment of Food and Agriculture Systems, FAO 2014). Es wurde von mehr als 60 Agrar- und Nachhaltigkeitsexperten entwickelt und besteht aus einer hocheffizienten Datenbank sowie einer wissenschaftlich fundierten Bewertungsmethode mit einem umfangreichen Indikatorpool. Die Bewertungsmethode beinhaltet unter anderem eine Gewichtung der Indikatoren nach dem Grad der Auswirkung auf die verschiedenen SAFA-Unterthemen. Darüber hinaus werden der Einflussbereich und die Verantwortung des jeweiligen Betriebes oder Unternehmens für die Auswirkungen auf die Nachhaltigkeit innerhalb der Lieferkette berücksichtigt. SMART ist kein neuer Standard, kein neues Zertifizierungssystem oder Label, sondern ausschließlich ein Analyse- und Bewertungsinstrument. Es konkurriert daher nicht mit bestehenden Standards und Zertifikaten, sondern ist eine nützliche Ergänzung. Das SMART-Tool wird von geschulten Anwender*innen eingesetzt. Daher sollte sich jeder, der an dem Tool interessiert ist, an die für das Tool Verantwortlichen wenden, um an einer Schulung teilnehmen zu können.

descOther:
Vous êtes à la recherche de solutions innovantes et fiables pour votre exploitation ? Champs d'Innovation est le nouveau site à consulter pour une veille professionnelle agricole efficace et objective.

Les internautes ont besoin de trouver des informations techniques et fiables de manière fluide et sécurisée, avec une information adaptée. Champs d'Innovation est un portail qui permet d'effectuer cette veille facilement.

Un site web agricole au service du monde agricole

Le portail Champs d'Innovation s'adresse aux agriculteurs, quel que soit leur type de productions, mais également aux conseillers, aux enseignants et aux étudiants. On y retrouve tout un panel d’innovations et de solutions agricoles disponibles, en particulier dans la région. Le portail a pour objectif d’aider les agriculteurs face aux problématiques multiples auxquelles ils sont confrontés tous les jours.

… Et vérifié

Il est conçu et animé en partenariat avec la Région Normandie, les Chambres d’agriculture de Normandie, Acta Normandie, Astredhor Seine-Manche, Bio en Normandie, CIVAM, CUMA Normandie, IFPC, SILEBAN et UniLaSalle. Il propose des solutions vérifiées par les experts, issues de sources fiables telles que les sites rd-agri.fr (CASDAR), Ecophytopic, collectifs-agroecologie, Innov’action, Ok éleveur ou encore Contrat de solutions.

Comment ça fonctionne ?

Grâce à son moteur de recherches, le portail de l'innovation :

   - permet d’orienter l’internaute vers de l’information pertinente, issue de sites web fiables et professionnels.
   - permet d’enregistrer ses recherches et de recevoir de nouveaux résultats par courriel, le tout gratuitement.
   - offre une liste de coordonnées d’experts normands par thématiques ou type de productions.
   - recense les évènements et portes ouvertes organisées en Normandie, autour de solutions testées directement sur les exploitations agricoles.

name: Teagasc Crop report platform
title: Seasonal analysis and updates of technical, agronomic information  relevant to crop growers their advisors and suppliers
desc:
The Crop Report platform is an extensive source of up to date information prepared by Teagasc Specialists, it includes field observations, the latest scientific trial results and practical management strategies for all the major crops in Ireland throughout the growing season.  
It is regarded as the industry standard for technical agronomy strategies.  The Crop Report has continually developed the information and format every year since publication, and a recent redesign is particularly suitable as a digital format. The Crop Report has a dedicated following of commercial agronomists and industry professionals subscribing every year and is regarded as a critical part of the technical Knowledge Transfer to the tillage industry.  
The Crop Report now can be viewed by anyone through a desktop web app and on mobile app platforms (Apple and Android).  This allows the user to save their preferences across platforms so that information of most interest to them can be viewed, either in the office, or out in the field on the mobile app.  All new users can avail of a 14 day free trial when first logged in.   
Agronomist use the Crop Report throughout the year.   Crop Reports are used regularly when walking crops, as it not only has the most up to date information on the current status of crops and a scientific rationale for specific management decisions.
The Crop Report resonates with farmers as the technical information is presented alongside detailed product information on fertilisers, plant protection products and agronomy strategies.  Regular updates on crops and issues in the field give farmers an early warning of possible issues to watch out for locally.  The Crop Report is available to Teagasc Clients who avail of a technical service from Teagasc.  However all farmers can partake in the 14 day free trial.  
The Crop Report systematically collates the available plant protection products which are commonly used by farmers each year. There are a wide array of herbicides, fungicides, etc. which are similar, but some may be more suitable in specific situations.  Products tables contain commentary about getting the best from these products in a safe and environmentally sustainable way. It is easy to quickly navigate to this information in the Crop Report app”.    
The Crop Report includes not only tillage crop information but a range of information around grassland, environment and cross compliance issues.
keywords: Cops, decision making, herbicides, fungicides
